consumables.name: Nine-Breath Recovery Pill
consumables.text:
You regain `2d8 + 2` Hit Points.
If you are at 0 Hit Points, another creature can administer the pill to you as an Action. This pill does not count against Essence Saturation.

consumables.name: Clear-Venom Antidote Pill
consumables.text:
You can immediately repeat one saving throw against the Poisoned condition or a poison currently affecting you, if that effect normally permits repeated saving throws. You make the save with Advantage.
If you are not currently affected by a poison, you instead have Advantage on the next saving throw you make against poison before the end of your next Short Rest. This pill does not count against Essence Saturation.

consumables.name: Fasting Meridian Pill
consumables.text:
For 7 days, you require no food and only half as much water.
The pill prevents hunger and ordinary malnutrition during that period, but it does not remove existing Exhaustion, replace special nutrients required by a species or cultivation method, or support accelerated growth.

consumables.name: Calming Heart Elixir
consumables.text:
For 1 hour, you have Advantage on saving throws against the Charmed and Frightened conditions and against hostile dream intrusion.
When you drink the elixir, you can immediately repeat one saving throw against one of those effects if it normally permits repeated saving throws.

consumables.name: Minor Qi-Returning Pill
consumables.text:
Regain expended CP, Stamina, or Resonance equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
A creature can regain a Path resource from this pill only once per Short Rest, even if it consumes additional copies.

consumables.name: Bone-Knitting Jade Paste
consumables.text:
Apply the paste to yourself or a creature within reach. The target regains `5d8 + 10` Hit Points.
The paste also ends one effect reducing the target's Speed because of a physical injury, closes ordinary open wounds, and repairs one broken mundane bone. It does not regrow a missing body part or end a supernatural curse.

consumables.name: Meridian-Cleansing Elixir
consumables.text:
Regain expended CP, Stamina, or Resonance equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus.
You can also immediately repeat one saving throw against an effect that prevents you from spending that resource, corrupts your circulation, or imposes a cultivation-related condition that normally permits repeated saves.
A creature can benefit from this elixir only once per Long Rest.

consumables.name: Furnace-Body Tempering Pill
consumables.text:
For 1 hour, you gain Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
Whenever you take fire damage during the duration, reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus after applying Resistance.
When the effect ends, you cannot Dash until the end of your next turn.

consumables.name: Nine-Revolution Restoration Pill
Dragon-Furnace Explosive Pellet
consumables.text:
The pellet detonates in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range.
Creatures in the area make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking `4d6` fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful save.
Unattended flammable objects in the area ignite.

consumables.name: Frost-Bloom Pellet
consumables.text:
The pellet creates a 10-foot-radius patch of supernatural frost for 1 minute.
Creatures in the area when it appears make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking `3d6` cold damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful save.
The area is Difficult Terrain. A creature entering the area for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there takes `1d6` cold damage.

consumables.name: Black-Dregs Smoke Pellet
consumables.text:
The pellet creates a 15-foot-radius sphere of Heavy Obscurement for 1 minute.
A moderate or stronger wind disperses the smoke. A creature that enters the smoke for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be unable to take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Creatures that do not breathe are immune to the saving throw effect.

consumables.name: Thunderclap Pellet
consumables.text:
The pellet detonates in a 10-foot-radius sphere.
Creatures in the area make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes `3d8` thunder damage, is Deafened until the end of its next turn, and cannot take Reactions until then. On a successful save, it takes half damage and suffers no other effect.

consumables.name: Bone-Melting Corrosive Pellet
consumables.text:
Make a ranged consumable attack with a +5 modifier against one creature, unattended object, or Formation component within range.
On a hit, the target takes `4d6` acid damage. An unattended object, structure, Array Eye, or Node takes maximum damage.
A nonmagical object reduced to 0 Hit Points by the pellet is dissolved rather than merely broken.

consumables.name: Five-Poison Cloud Pellet
consumables.text:
The pellet creates a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous smoke for 1 minute.
Creatures in the area when it appears make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes `6d6` poison damage and is Poisoned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half damage.
A creature entering the cloud for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there repeats the save against `3d6` poison damage. A strong wind disperses the cloud.

consumables.name: Soul-Shock Pellet
consumables.text:
The pellet detonates in a 15-foot-radius sphere.
Creatures in the area make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes `5d8` psychic damage and is Frightened of the detonation point until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half damage.
Undead, possessing entities, and incorporeal spirits make the saving throw with Disadvantage.

consumables.name: Gravity-Well Pellet
consumables.text:
The pellet creates a 15-foot-radius gravity well centered on a point within range until the end of your next turn.
Creatures in the area when it appears make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes `4d8` force damage, is pulled to the nearest unoccupied space adjacent to the center, and falls Prone. On a successful save, it takes half damage and is not moved.
The area is Difficult Terrain until the effect ends.

consumables.name: Calamity-Star Pellet
consumables.text:
The pellet descends as a violent star in a 20-foot-radius sphere.
Creatures in the area make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes `6d8` lightning damage and `6d8` force damage and falls Prone. On a successful save, it takes half damage and remains standing.
Unattended objects and Formation components take maximum force damage.

consumables.name: Imperial Sunfire Annihilation Pellet
consumables.text:
The pellet creates a 30-foot-radius sphere of white-gold fire.
Creatures in the area make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes `10d8` fire damage and `10d8` radiant damage. On a successful save, it takes half damage.
A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.
Imperial or stronger barriers take normal damage; all weaker unattended barriers and Formation components take maximum damage.

consumables.name: Swift-Step Talisman
consumables.text:
Affix or tear the talisman to move up to 20 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
You cannot move through occupied spaces or terrain you could not normally enter. This is movement, not teleportation.

consumables.name: Body-Guarding Talisman
consumables.text:
Reduce the triggering damage by `2d8 + 3`.
If this reduces the damage to 0, you can move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the source of the damage.

consumables.name: Firebolt Talisman
consumables.text:
Make a ranged consumable attack with a +5 modifier against one creature or object within 90 feet.
On a hit, the target takes `4d8` fire damage.

consumables.name: Ghost-Warding Door Seal
consumables.text:
The seal protects one door, window, gate, coffin lid, or similar opening no wider than 10 feet for 8 hours.
An Undead, incorporeal spirit, or possessing entity attempting to cross must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it cannot cross for 1 hour and takes `3d8` radiant damage. On a successful save, it crosses and destroys the seal.
The seal has AC 13 and 5 Hit Points.

consumables.name: Water-Breathing Talisman
consumables.text:
For 1 hour, the target can breathe air and water and can speak normally underwater.
The target does not gain a Swim Speed or protection from deep-water pressure.

consumables.name: Thunder-Escape Talisman
consumables.text:
After the triggering damage resolves, teleport up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
Creatures within 5 feet of the space you left make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking `3d8` lightning damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful save.
A sealed spatial boundary can prevent the teleportation.

consumables.name: Meridian-Sealing Talisman
consumables.text:
Make a ranged consumable attack with a +7 modifier against one creature within 30 feet.
On a hit, the talisman affixes to the target. The target makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, until the end of your next turn it cannot take Reactions or spend CP, Stamina, Resonance, or another Path resource. On a successful save, it cannot take Reactions until the end of the current turn.
The talisman is destroyed after resolving.

consumables.activation: Reaction when a visible creature hits you with an attack
consumables.name: Mirror-Reversal Talisman
consumables.text:
Reduce the triggering damage by `4d8 + 5`.
If this reduces the damage to 0, make a ranged consumable attack with a +7 modifier against the attacker if it is within 120 feet. On a hit, it takes `4d8` force damage.
The reflected attack does not carry the attacker's original effects.

consumables.name: Nine-Lock Demon Suppression Seal
consumables.text:
Choose one Gargantuan or smaller creature within 60 feet. It makes a DC 17 Charisma saving throw.
On a failed save, spectral chains bind it for up to 1 minute. While bound, it is Restrained, cannot become Invisible, cannot possess another creature, and cannot teleport or travel between planes.
At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
On the initial successful save, its Speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

consumables.name: Clear-Mind Study Incense
consumables.text:
Creatures within 10 feet have Advantage on checks made to maintain concentration during study, copying, translation, meditation, or analysis despite ordinary noise and discomfort.
The incense does not grant Concentration on a supernatural effect or prevent interruption by combat.

consumables.name: Soul-Scent Appraisal Incense
consumables.text:
While the incense burns, visible smoke bends toward the nearest corpse, spirit, possessed creature, soul-bound treasure, or object carrying strong spiritual residue within 30 feet.
The smoke identifies the broad category but not the creature's identity, allegiance, grade, or exact effect. Total Cover blocks the reading.

consumables.name: Nine-Herb Healing Incense
consumables.text:
Up to six creatures that remain within 10 feet for the full Short Rest regain an additional `1d8 + 2` Hit Points if they spend at least one Hit Die.
A creature can benefit from only one Nine-Herb Healing Incense during a Short Rest.

consumables.name: Beast-Calming Cedar Incense
consumables.text:
Beasts, willing spirit companions, and Monstrosities with Intelligence 5 or lower within 20 feet have Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition.
A hostile qualifying creature entering the area must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take Reactions while it remains in the smoke.
After a creature succeeds on the save, it is immune to this incense for 24 hours.

consumables.activation: Light at the start of a Long Rest
consumables.name: Dreamless-Sleep Incense
consumables.text:
Up to six willing creatures within 10 feet have Advantage on saving throws against magical sleep, nightmare effects, and hostile dream intrusion during the Long Rest.
A creature that completes the rest remembers no ordinary dreams and has Advantage on the first saving throw it makes against Frightened before its next Long Rest.

consumables.name: Meridian-Recovery Incense
consumables.text:
Up to six creatures that remain within 15 feet for the full Short Rest regain expended CP, Stamina, or Resonance equal to their Proficiency Bonus.
Each affected creature counts as having consumed one Saturating consumable.
A creature can benefit from this incense only once per Long Rest.

consumables.name: Ghost-Banishing Incense
consumables.text:
The incense fills a 20-foot-radius area.
An Undead, incorporeal spirit, or possessing entity entering the area for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a DC 15 Charisma saving throw.
On a failed save, it takes `4d8` radiant damage and cannot enter the area again until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half damage.
A strong wind disperses the incense.

consumables.name: Incense of Truthful Counsel
consumables.text:
Creatures willingly conversing within 15 feet have Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks made toward one another.
When a creature knowingly speaks a direct factual lie, it must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or the smoke briefly turns black around its mouth.
The incense does not expose omissions, compel speech, or determine objective truth.

consumables.name: Ancestor-Calling Temple Incense
consumables.text:
Present a true name, blood relation, funerary tablet, or personal relic connected to a deceased ancestor.
If the spirit remains reachable and willing, it manifests within the smoke for up to 1 hour. It can see and hear within 30 feet, speak, and answer questions using its own knowledge.
During the manifestation, allied descendants within 30 feet have Advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws.
The incense cannot compel, bind, reconstruct, or contact a destroyed or reincarnated soul.

consumables.name: Imperial Heaven-Cleansing Incense
consumables.text:
The incense fills a 60-foot-radius area for 10 minutes. Hostile smoke, gas, poison clouds, disease-bearing vapors, and non-Imperial airborne effects are immediately dispersed.
Creatures of your choice entering the area or starting their turn there can end one poison, disease, Charmed, Frightened, or possession effect of Imperial grade or lower.
Each creature can receive this cleansing only once from the incense.
An Imperial effect can resist with an opposed ability check against DC 19. Immortal effects are unaffected.

consumables.name: Spirit-Grain Recovery Wine
consumables.text:
You regain `2d6 + 3` Hit Points.
For 10 minutes, you have Advantage on saving throws against ordinary environmental cold. This wine does not count against Essence Saturation.

consumables.name: Iron-Bone Broth
consumables.text:
You gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus. They last until your next Long Rest.
You also have Advantage on the next Strength saving throw you make before your next Long Rest.

consumables.name: Cloudstep Plum Wine
consumables.text:
For 1 hour, your Speed increases by 5 feet, and you add 10 feet to your long jump distance and 5 feet to your high jump height.
When the effect ends, you cannot benefit from another Cloudstep Plum Wine until you complete a Short Rest.

consumables.name: Moon-Dew Clarity Tea
consumables.text:
For 1 hour, you gain Darkvision out to 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet.
You also have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to notice illusions, spirits, or reflected light during the duration.

consumables.name: Seven-Day Fasting Cake
consumables.text:
One serving provides sufficient food for 7 days.
The cake does not spoil and weighs 1 ounce. It does not provide water, remove existing starvation, or satisfy a special cultivation diet.
This food is not Saturating.

consumables.activation: Consume during a Short or Long Rest
consumables.name: Five-Flavor Warrior Feast
consumables.text:
Choose one flavor when the feast is prepared. A creature eating one serving gains the associated benefit until its next Long Rest:
- **Bitter:** Advantage on saving throws against poison and disease.
- **Sweet:** Temporary Hit Points equal to three times Proficiency Bonus.
- **Sour:** Advantage on initiative rolls.
- **Spicy:** Speed increases by 10 feet.
- **Savory:** Add `1d4` to the first saving throw made in each scene.
A creature can benefit from only one flavor at a time.

consumables.name: Dragon-Marrow Strength Wine
consumables.text:
For 1 hour, you have Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and you count as one size larger for carrying capacity and determining what you can Grapple or Shove.
Once during each of your turns when you hit with a melee weapon attack, add `1d6` damage of the weapon's type.
When the effect ends, you cannot Dash until the end of your next turn.

consumables.name: Phoenix-Heart Restoration Soup
consumables.text:
You regain `6d8 + 15` Hit Points and can remove one level of Exhaustion.
A creature can remove only one level of Exhaustion from this soup between Long Rests.
For 1 hour after the meal, you have Resistance to fire damage.

consumables.name: Nine-Course Sovereign Dao Banquet
Imperial Feast of Returning Spring
consumables.text:
A creature eating the feast regains all Hit Points and Hit Dice, removes two levels of Exhaustion, and ends all poisons, diseases, and non-Immortal effects imposing Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned.
For the next 24 hours, its Hit Point maximum increases by five times its Proficiency Bonus.
A creature can benefit from this feast only once per month.

consumables.name: Numbing Needle Venom
consumables.text:
Apply one dose to one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition. The poison remains potent for 1 minute or until it damages a creature.
The first creature damaged makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes `3d6` poison damage and cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half damage.

consumables.activation: Bonus Action to apply or Action to administer
consumables.name: Sleep-Lotus Extract
consumables.text:
A creature exposed to the poison makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, it is Poisoned for 1 minute. While Poisoned this way, its Speed is halved. If it fails the save by 5 or more, it is also Unconscious until it takes damage or another creature uses an Action to wake it.
On a successful save, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

consumables.name: Meridian-Stiffening Oil
consumables.text:
A creature exposed to the oil makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, its Speed is reduced by 15 feet and it cannot Dash for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on a success.
On a successful initial save, its Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the end of its next turn.

consumables.name: Spirit-Beast Hunter Toxin
consumables.text:
Apply one dose to one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition for 1 minute.
A Beast or Monstrosity damaged by the coated attack takes an additional `4d6` poison damage and makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it cannot regain Hit Points until the start of the attacker's next turn.
Other creature types take `2d6` poison damage and make no saving throw.

consumables.name: Truth-Loosening Draught
consumables.text:
A creature ingesting the draught makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, it is Poisoned for 1 hour. While Poisoned this way, it has Disadvantage on Charisma (Deception) checks and must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw to knowingly speak a direct factual lie.
The draught does not compel speech, expose omissions, or reveal objective truth.

consumables.name: Ghost-Scorch Resin
consumables.text:
Apply one dose to one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition for 1 minute.
When the coated weapon damages an Undead, possessing entity, summoned spirit, or incorporeal creature, it deals an additional `5d8` radiant damage.
The target makes a DC 15 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it cannot become Invisible, possess a creature, or move through solid objects until the end of its next turn.
Against other targets, the resin has no effect.

consumables.name: Qi-Draining Black Venom
consumables.text:
A creature damaged by the coated weapon makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, it takes `4d8` poison damage, loses expended or available CP, Stamina, or Resonance equal to its Proficiency Bonus, and cannot regain that resource until the end of its next turn.
On a successful save, it takes half damage and loses no resource.
This poison cannot reduce a resource below 0.

consumables.activation: Action to spread over a 5-foot square or object
consumables.name: Hundred-Ache Contact Poison
consumables.text:
The poison remains active for 1 hour.
A creature touching the treated surface with bare skin makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, it takes `5d6` poison damage and is Poisoned for 1 minute. While Poisoned this way, it has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity ability checks. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the condition on a success.
A successful save halves the damage.

consumables.name: Sovereign Soul-Corrosion Poison
consumables.text:
The first creature damaged by the treated weapon makes a DC 17 Charisma saving throw.
On a failed save, it takes `8d8` psychic damage, is Stunned until the end of its next turn, and cannot regain Hit Points until then.
On a successful save, it takes half damage and is not Stunned.
Undead, possessing entities, and incorporeal spirits make the saving throw with Disadvantage. A creature without a soul or animating spirit is immune.

consumables.name: Imperial Emperor-Killing Venom
consumables.text:
The first creature damaged by the treated weapon makes a DC 19 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, it takes `10d10` poison damage and `10d10` necrotic damage. Its Hit Point maximum is reduced by the necrotic damage taken until it completes three Long Rests or receives an Imperial restoration.
On a successful save, it takes half damage and its maximum is not reduced.
If the target is immune to poison, it treats that Immunity as Resistance against this dose. Immortal creatures use their normal Immunity.

consumables.name: Alert Boundary Stake Kit
consumables.text:
Place three Nodes and one Eye to define a 20-foot-radius area for 8 hours.
When a Tiny or larger creature crosses the boundary without speaking the chosen password, the Eye emits a clear tone audible within 300 feet.
The Nodes have AC 13 and 10 Hit Points. The Eye has AC 13 and 15 Hit Points. Destroying two Nodes or the Eye collapses the array.

consumables.name: Mist-Hiding Array Plates
consumables.text:
Place three plates and one Eye around a 20-foot-radius area for 8 hours.
From outside the area, creatures and objects within appear obscured by ordinary mist, granting Three-Quarters Cover against visual observation and ranged attacks passing through the boundary.
The mist does not obscure vision from inside and does not block sound.
The Nodes have AC 13 and 10 Hit Points. The Eye has AC 13 and 15 Hit Points.

consumables.name: Spirit-Gathering Rest Array Mat
consumables.text:
Unfold the mat and place three jade Nodes around a 15-foot-radius area for one Short Rest.
Up to six creatures completing the rest inside can reroll one Hit Die spent during the rest and must use the new result.
A creature meditating instead of spending Hit Dice has Advantage on one cultivation or circulation check made during the rest.
The array does not restore CP, grant training time, or function during a Long Rest.

consumables.name: Firebreak Array Tiles
consumables.text:
Throw the Eye to a point within 30 feet, creating a 10-foot-radius array for 1 minute. The Eye has AC 13 and 15 Hit Points.
Creatures in the area have Resistance to fire damage. Ordinary flames entering the area are extinguished.
A magical fire effect entering or appearing in the area is suppressed until the start of its creator's next turn if its creator fails an ability check against DC 13.

consumables.name: Minor Binding Array Flags
consumables.text:
Throw three flags and an Eye to create a 10-foot-radius array centered on a point within 30 feet for 1 minute. The Eye has AC 13 and 15 Hit Points.
A hostile creature entering the area for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, its Speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the area is Difficult Terrain for it until then.

consumables.name: Five-Phase Shelter Array
consumables.text:
Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison during setup. Place three Nodes and one Eye to protect a 30-foot-radius area for 8 hours.
Creatures and objects inside have Resistance to the chosen damage type.
The Nodes have AC 15 and 25 Hit Points. The Eye has AC 15 and 40 Hit Points. Destroying two Nodes or the Eye collapses the array.

consumables.name: Twin-Gate Transit Array Plates
consumables.text:
Place one plate at each of two fixed locations on the same plane within 10 miles.
For 8 hours, a willing creature adjacent to one plate can use an Action to teleport to the nearest unoccupied space adjacent to the other.
The pair transports up to twenty creatures or 5,000 pounds of unattended cargo before collapsing.
Each plate has AC 15 and 40 Hit Points. A sealed spatial boundary prevents transit.

consumables.name: Formation-Breaking Spike Set
consumables.text:
Drive or throw one spike into the space of a visible Formation Node, Eye, or Anchor within 30 feet.
Make a formation-breaking check with a +7 modifier against the formation's save DC.
On a success, the component is suppressed until the end of your next turn. On a success by 5 or more, it is suppressed for 1 minute.
A spike is consumed after the check. Suppressing an Eye suspends the formation without destroying it.

consumables.name: Nine-Palace Battlefield Disk
consumables.text:
Place the disk at a point within 60 feet to create a 40-foot-radius array for 1 minute. The Eye has AC 17 and 75 Hit Points.
The array divides its area into nine equal symbolic palaces.
When a hostile creature moves from one palace into another, it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it returns to the last unoccupied space it occupied in the previous palace, and its Speed becomes 0 until the end of the turn.
Allies can move between palaces normally and gain Half Cover while adjacent to a palace boundary.

consumables.name: Smoke-Step Escape Bead
consumables.text:
Crush the bead to create a 10-foot-radius sphere of Heavy Obscurement centered on you until the start of your next turn.
You can immediately move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
A strong wind disperses the smoke.

consumables.name: Earth-Passing Jade Shard
consumables.text:
Touch a nonmagical stone, earth, or brick barrier no more than 5 feet thick.
You teleport to the nearest unoccupied space directly on the opposite side. If no such space exists within 10 feet, the shard fails but is not consumed.
The shard cannot cross metal, magical barriers, Formation boundaries, or worked material reinforced by a supernatural effect.

consumables.name: River-Current Escape Token
consumables.text:
While touching a body of liquid at least 5 feet across, crush the token to teleport to an unoccupied space touching the same connected body of liquid within 60 feet.
You need not see the destination, but you must know its direction. If no legal space exists, the token fails but is not consumed.

consumables.name: Featherfall Escape Charm
consumables.text:
You and up to five falling creatures within 30 feet descend at 60 feet per round until landing.
Affected creatures take no falling damage and land on their feet if not Incapacitated.
The charm ends for a creature when it lands.

consumables.activation: Reaction when a creature targets you with an attack
consumables.name: Beast-Decoy Skin Doll
consumables.text:
Create an illusory duplicate in your space and move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker.
The triggering attack targets the duplicate instead and automatically misses you unless the attacker can perceive through illusions.
The duplicate disappears after the attack resolves.

consumables.name: Void-Step Jade Shard
consumables.text:
Teleport up to 90 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
Until the start of your next turn, attacks made against you from more than 30 feet away have Disadvantage.
A sealed spatial boundary can prevent the teleportation.

consumables.name: Thousand-Li Return Seal
consumables.text:
During a prior 10-minute rite, register one fixed return point.
Activate the seal to teleport yourself and up to five willing creatures within 10 feet to unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the registered point, provided it is on the same plane and within 100 miles.
A sealed spatial boundary, moving destination, or occupied arrival area causes the seal to fail without being consumed.

consumables.activation: Reaction when you are hit by an attack
consumables.name: Thunder-Shell Substitution Doll
consumables.text:
Reduce the triggering damage to 0 and teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
The doll appears in your former space and explodes. Creatures within 5 feet make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking `4d8` lightning damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful save.
The doll cannot negate damage from an Immortal effect.

consumables.activation: No action when you would drop to 0 Hit Points
consumables.name: Life-Saving Golden Cicada
consumables.text:
You drop to 1 Hit Point instead.
You then teleport, with all worn and carried equipment, to an unoccupied space within 1 mile that you designated when you last completed a Long Rest.
You become Invisible and Incapacitated until the end of your next turn. The invisibility ends early if you take damage.
The cicada cannot function across a sealed spatial boundary or against an effect that kills without reducing Hit Points.

consumables.name: Imperial Boundary-Breaking Escape Order
consumables.text:
Choose one location on the same plane that you have personally visited.
You and up to twenty willing creatures within 30 feet teleport to unoccupied spaces within 100 feet of that location.
The order ignores non-Imperial teleportation barriers. Against an Imperial barrier, make an ability check with a +11 modifier against its save DC. On a failure, the order is not consumed.
The order cannot cross planes, enter a location sealed by an Immortal effect, or arrive inside solid matter.

consumables.name: Flame-Tongue Weapon Oil
consumables.text:
One application coats one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition for 1 minute.
Each qualifying hit deals an additional `1d6` fire damage.
The coating ends after three hits or when the duration expires.

consumables.name: Frostbite Edge Oil
consumables.text:
One application coats one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition for 1 minute.
Each qualifying hit deals an additional `1d4` cold damage and reduces the target's Speed by 5 feet until the start of the attacker's next turn. This Speed reduction stacks to a maximum of 10 feet.
The coating ends after three hits or when the duration expires.

consumables.name: Thunderburst Ammunition
consumables.text:
When this ammunition hits, the target takes an additional `2d6` lightning damage.
If the target is wearing metal armor or made primarily of metal, the additional damage becomes `3d6`.
The ammunition is destroyed after the attack, whether it hits or misses.

consumables.name: Ghost-Touch Lacquer
consumables.text:
One application coats one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition for 1 minute.
Attacks made with the coated weapon count as magical, can damage incorporeal creatures normally, and deal an additional `1d6` force damage to Undead, possessing entities, and incorporeal spirits.
The coating ends after three hits or when the duration expires.

consumables.name: Armor-Eating Acid Varnish
consumables.text:
One application coats one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition for 1 minute.
Hits deal an additional `1d6` acid damage. Against Constructs, unattended objects, structures, armor treasures, Formation Nodes, and Array Eyes, the acid damage is maximized.
The coating ends after three hits or when the duration expires.

consumables.name: Soul-Piercing Needle Set
consumables.text:
A needle has a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 90 feet. Make a ranged consumable attack with a +7 modifier.
On a hit, the target takes `3d8` piercing damage and `3d8` psychic damage.
An Undead, possessing entity, or incorporeal spirit must also succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be unable to become Invisible or move through solid objects until the end of its next turn.
The needle is destroyed after the attack.

consumables.name: Formation-Breaking Arrowheads
consumables.text:
When the ammunition hits a Formation Node, Eye, Anchor, magical barrier, or object created by a supernatural effect, it deals an additional `5d6` force damage.
The attack ignores Resistance possessed by that object, but not Immunity.
If the object is reduced to 0 Hit Points, its linked effect ends immediately unless its own rules state otherwise.
The ammunition is destroyed after the attack.

consumables.name: Void-Nail Weapon Coating
consumables.text:
One application coats one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition for 1 minute.
A creature hit by the coated weapon takes an additional `2d8` force damage and cannot teleport or travel between planes until the start of the attacker's next turn.
The coating ends after three hits or when the duration expires.

consumables.name: Calamity-Fletched Ammunition
consumables.text:
When the ammunition hits, the target takes an additional `6d8` lightning damage and `2d8` thunder damage.
The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be unable to take Reactions and have Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.
The ammunition is destroyed after the attack.

consumables.name: Imperial Heaven-Splitting Weapon Oil
consumables.text:
Coat one weapon for 1 minute.
Each hit deals an additional `4d8` force damage and ignores Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, and force damage.
Against an unattended object, structure, Formation component, or magical barrier, the additional force damage becomes `8d8` and is maximized.
The oil ends after three hits or when the duration expires.

wondrous.construction: Void crystal set in spirit silver
wondrous.name: Cultivator's Storage Ring
wondrous.text:
The ring contains an extradimensional space holding up to **500 pounds or 32 cubic feet**, whichever limit is reached first.
**Store.** As an Action, touch one unattended object that fits through a 3-foot-wide opening and place it in the ring.
**Retrieve.** As a Bonus Action, retrieve one hand-held object whose location in the ring you know. Retrieving a larger object requires an Action.
The interior has no air and cannot hold living creatures. A living creature forced inside is immediately expelled into the nearest unoccupied space and takes `2d6` force damage.
Placing the ring inside another extradimensional space destroys both containers and scatters their contents into random unoccupied spaces within 100 feet.

wondrous.construction: Living gourd lined with frost jade
wondrous.name: Hundred-Herb Preservation Gourd
wondrous.text:
The gourd holds up to **100 pounds or 8 cubic feet** of herbs, flowers, fungi, seeds, medicinal roots, and other plant ingredients.
Contents do not rot, dry out, germinate, or lose alchemical potency while stored. Time spent in the gourd does not count against a harvested ingredient's normal freshness limit.
Storing or retrieving one handful, bundle, vial, or Harvest Lot requires a Bonus Action. Larger quantities require an Action.

wondrous.construction: Cloud silk sewn around a void-crystal clasp
wondrous.name: Folded-Sleeve Satchel
wondrous.text:
The satchel holds up to **250 pounds or 16 cubic feet**. Its opening expands to accommodate an unattended object no wider than 1 foot.
**Store.** Storing an object requires an Action.
**Retrieve.** Retrieving a hand-held object requires a Bonus Action; retrieving anything larger requires an Action.
The satchel cannot contain creatures, active flames, or an object already containing extradimensional space. Attempting the last of these causes the inserted object to rebound harmlessly from the opening.

wondrous.construction: Lacquered clay and spirit-beast bone
wondrous.name: Beast-Feed Preservation Jar
wondrous.text:
The jar holds up to **50 pounds** of feed, meat, grain, medicinal mash, or similar food intended for beasts or companions.
Food stored inside remains fresh and free of ordinary vermin. As an Action, you can cause one meal removed from the jar to become comfortably warm or cool.
A Beast or bonded companion that eats a full meal from the jar has Advantage on the next saving throw it makes against ordinary environmental heat, cold, hunger, or thirst before its next Long Rest.

wondrous.construction: White jade, silk dividers, and sealing wax
wondrous.name: Talisman-Flat Jade Case
wondrous.text:
The case protects up to **20 paper talismans, command slips, or similarly flat inscriptions** from water, ordinary fire, tearing, and accidental activation.
You can draw one identified talisman from the case as part of the action used to activate it.
As an Action, touch a talisman in the case to learn its name, grade, activation type, and whether it has been damaged. This property does not reveal hidden curses or intentionally concealed functions.

wondrous.construction: Scholar jade and folded paperwood
wondrous.name: Scholar's Thousand-Page Box
wondrous.text:
The box holds up to **1,000 pages**, 20 scrolls, or 10 ordinary books without increasing its 3-pound weight.
Contents are protected from ordinary moisture, insects, dust, and fading.
When you speak the title, author, first line, or a unique description of a stored text, the box presents it at the top as an Object Interaction. If no stored text matches, the lid remains closed.

wondrous.construction: Spirit bamboo rods and source-jade beads
wondrous.name: Spirit-Stone Counting Abacus
wondrous.text:
As an Action, place the abacus beside a visible pile or open container holding coins, spirit shards, or spirit stones. It displays the exact number and total rules value of those objects, up to **10,000 individual pieces**.
The abacus identifies cracked, exhausted, or visibly counterfeit spirit stones but does not reveal a sophisticated magical forgery.
You have Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to audit a merchant ledger involving counted currency.

wondrous.construction: Moon silver and frost jade
wondrous.name: Cold-Moon Medicine Chest
wondrous.text:
The chest holds up to **20 medicine doses, healer's-kit uses, pills, or small biological samples**.
Contents remain cool, sterile, and preserved. Ordinary disease cannot spread between samples stored in separate compartments.
When you use a healer's kit or medicinal treasure taken directly from the chest, you can reroll one die that rolls a 1. You must use the new result. This benefit can be used once, and it refreshes when you complete a Long Rest.

wondrous.construction: Ironwood, spirit bronze, and cleaning sigils
wondrous.name: Dustless Workshop Chest
wondrous.text:
The chest stores one complete set of artisan's tools and up to **50 pounds** of related mundane supplies.
As a 1-minute procedure, it unfolds into a stable 5-foot-square workbench. Tools placed on the bench remain clean, sorted, and within reach.
During a Short Rest, the chest can clean and perform routine maintenance on one tool set. It cannot repair a Broken treasure or replace consumed materials.

wondrous.construction: Cloud silk and merchant-house jade
wondrous.name: Merchant's Weightless Ledger Pouch
wondrous.text:
The pouch holds up to **50 pounds** of coins, trade bars, receipts, contracts, seals, and nonmagical documents while always weighing 1 pound.
The pouch refuses weapons, creatures, food, raw crafting materials, and unidentified supernatural treasures.
As an Action, you can command it to arrange stored coins and documents into labeled internal compartments. This changes organization only and does not verify authenticity.

wondrous.construction: Cloud jade and wind-thread lacing
wondrous.name: Cloudstep Jade Anklets
wondrous.text:
Your Speed increases by **5 feet**.
You ignore the first 10 feet of nonmagical Difficult Terrain you move through during each of your turns.
The anklets have 3 charges and regain `1d3` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest. As a Bonus Action, expend 1 charge to increase your jump distance by 15 feet and jump height by 5 feet until the end of the turn.

wondrous.construction: Spirit reeds, river jade, and water silk
wondrous.name: River-Crossing Reed Sandals
wondrous.text:
During your turn, you can move across calm or flowing liquid as though it were solid ground. Liquid is Difficult Terrain for you unless you possess a Swim Speed.
If you end your turn standing on liquid without another feature supporting you, you descend harmlessly into it.
You have Advantage on checks made to keep your footing on wet stone, ice, a ship's deck, or a narrow river crossing.

wondrous.construction: Gecko-beast hide and earth-thread stitching
wondrous.name: Cliff-Clinging Gecko Gloves
wondrous.text:
You gain a **Climb Speed of 20 feet** while both hands are free.
You can remain attached to a vertical surface without making an ability check. You cannot cling to a ceiling unless another feature permits it.
When you fall within reach of a solid surface, you can use your Reaction to make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a success, you catch the surface and stop falling.

wondrous.construction: Storm bamboo and crane feathers
wondrous.name: Wind-Reading Travel Fan
wondrous.text:
You have Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to predict weather or identify a safe direction of travel using wind, smoke, clouds, or scent.
The fan has 3 charges and regains all expended charges at dawn.
**Clear the Air.** As an Action, expend 1 charge to disperse nonmagical smoke, fog, dust, or harmless gas in a 10-foot cube within 30 feet.
**Weather Reading.** As a 1-minute procedure, expend 1 charge to learn the natural weather expected within 1 mile during the next 6 hours.

wondrous.construction: Magnetized spirit iron and home-soil jade
wondrous.name: Homeward Compass Disc
wondrous.text:
During an 8-hour ritual performed at one fixed location, designate that place as the disc's home.
While you are on the same plane and within **100 miles** of home, the disc points toward it and displays the straight-line distance to the nearest mile.
A new ritual replaces the previous home. A dimensional barrier, sealed domain, or effect that blocks divination can cause the disc to spin without providing false information.

wondrous.construction: Two matched jade tiles
wondrous.name: Thousand-Li Trail Marker
wondrous.text:
The treasure consists of two matched tiles.
While both tiles are on the same plane and within **10 miles**, each points toward the other and displays their straight-line distance.
As an Action, a creature holding one tile can cause both to emit the same visible symbol for 1 minute. This function can be used once and refreshes at dawn.

wondrous.construction: Waterproof cloud wool and mist jade
wondrous.name: Mist-Sheltering Travel Cloak
wondrous.text:
The cloak keeps you and ordinary clothing beneath it dry in rain, snow, and mist. You have Advantage on saving throws against Exhaustion caused solely by ordinary extreme heat, extreme cold, or wet exposure.
Once per Long Rest, as a 1-minute procedure, spread the cloak on the ground to create a dry 10-foot-radius shelter for up to 8 hours. The shelter blocks ordinary rain, snow, wind, and insects but provides no Cover.

wondrous.construction: Spirit bamboo and gravity jade
wondrous.name: Floating Burden Pole
wondrous.text:
When activated as an Action, the pole floats 3 feet above the ground and can support up to **250 pounds** of secured cargo.
It follows the activating creature at a Speed of 30 feet, remaining within 5 feet whenever possible. It cannot climb, fly, cross a gap wider than 10 feet, or enter a space too small for its load.
If overloaded, it settles gently to the ground and becomes inactive.

wondrous.construction: Two matched whisper jades
wondrous.name: Paired Whispering Jade
wondrous.text:
Each jade has 3 charges and regains all expended charges at dawn.
As an Action, expend 1 charge and speak a message of no more than **25 words**. The paired jade reproduces the message in your voice if it is on the same plane and within **1 mile**.
A creature holding the receiving jade can answer immediately with up to 25 words without expending a charge. Total silence, planar separation, or a sealed communication barrier prevents delivery.

wondrous.construction: Colored spirit glass and bronze
wondrous.name: Sect-Signal Lantern
wondrous.text:
As a Bonus Action, choose the lantern's color and whether its light is visible normally or only to creatures carrying a matching sect token.
In clear conditions, the signal is visible from **5 miles** away.
As an Action, cause the lantern to display one of twelve symbols chosen when it is created. The symbols carry no automatic meaning; a group must agree on its own code.

wondrous.construction: Court bronze and clear-heart jade
wondrous.name: Truth-Resonance Court Bell
wondrous.text:
The bell has 3 charges and regains `1d3` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
After a creature within 10 feet makes a factual statement of no more than 25 words, you can use your Reaction and expend 1 charge. An unwilling speaker makes a DC 13 Charisma saving throw.
On a failed save, the bell produces a clear tone if the speaker believes the statement is true and a discordant tone if the speaker believes it is false. On a successful save, the bell remains silent.
The bell does not determine objective truth, expose omissions, or interpret predictions.

wondrous.construction: Dream jade and memory ink
wondrous.name: Memory-Impression Jade Slip
wondrous.text:
The slip stores up to **three recordings**, each containing up to 10 minutes of your sight and hearing.
As an Action, begin or end a recording. Starting a fourth recording erases the oldest.
A creature touching the slip can replay one recording during an equal amount of real time. The viewer knows it is experiencing a recording and remains aware of its surroundings, though it has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks during playback.

wondrous.construction: Clear jade and moon silver
wondrous.name: Hidden-Writing Revealing Lens
wondrous.text:
While looking through the lens, you can see invisible ink, erased writing, concealed talisman strokes, and nonphysical formation lines within 10 feet.
The lens reveals the location and shape of such writing but does not translate it, identify its function, or reveal invisible creatures.
You have Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to determine whether a document has been altered.

wondrous.construction: Funeral bronze and ghost iron
wondrous.name: Grave-Quiet Listening Bell
wondrous.text:
The bell has 1 charge and regains it at midnight.
As an Action, expend the charge and ring the bell. For 1 minute, it vibrates whenever an Undead creature, incorporeal spirit, or possessing entity is within 60 feet and not behind Total Cover.
The direction of the vibration indicates the nearest qualifying presence. The bell does not identify the creature or reveal an exact location.

wondrous.construction: Source jade and magnetized silver
wondrous.name: Source-Vein Appraisal Needle
wondrous.text:
Plant the needle in soil or exposed stone and spend 10 minutes observing it.
You learn whether a natural mineral deposit, spirit-stone vein, buried source material, or major underground hollow lies within **300 feet**.
If one exists, the needle indicates its general direction and whether its apparent concentration is trace, minor, substantial, or exceptional. It does not reveal hazards, ownership, exact depth, or sealed contents.

wondrous.construction: Dream silk and moon cotton
wondrous.name: Dream-Recording Pillow
wondrous.text:
A creature that completes a Long Rest using the pillow remembers its dreams clearly for 24 hours.
At waking, the dreamer can cause one page placed beneath the pillow to display a symbolic illustration and a summary of no more than 100 words describing the dream. The page records the dreamer's honest memory, not hidden prophecy or objective truth.
The dreamer has Advantage on checks made during that day to recall or interpret its own recorded dream.

wondrous.construction: Clear-heart bronze and sun jade
wondrous.name: Clear-Mind Bronze Bell
wondrous.text:
The bell has 3 charges and regains `1d3` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
As an Action, expend 1 charge and ring the bell. You and allies of your choice within 10 feet gain Advantage on the next saving throw made against the Charmed or Frightened condition before the end of your next turn.
A creature currently affected by either condition can immediately repeat one saving throw against it if the effect normally allows repeated saves.

wondrous.construction: Spirit grass, cloud cotton, and grounding thread
wondrous.name: Still-Breath Cultivation Mat
wondrous.text:
While seated on the mat, you can meditate comfortably despite ordinary noise, weather, hard ground, or minor physical discomfort.
When you finish a Short Rest on the mat and spend one or more Hit Dice, reroll one Hit Die and use either result. This benefit can be granted to only one creature per Short Rest.
The mat does not shorten cultivation training or permit resting in immediate danger.

wondrous.construction: Sun copper and medicine jade
wondrous.name: Meridian-Warming Hand Furnace
wondrous.text:
The furnace produces safe, smokeless warmth without fuel.
A creature holding it has Advantage on saving throws against ordinary extreme cold and can warm one meal or 1 gallon of liquid during a Short Rest.
Once per Long Rest, a creature completing a Short Rest beside the furnace can end one instance of numbness, chilled limbs, or reduced Speed caused solely by ordinary cold exposure.

wondrous.construction: Spirit bronze and incense jade
wondrous.name: Spirit-Gathering Incense Burner
wondrous.text:
During a Short or Long Rest, burn incense worth 1 Spirit Shard.
Choose one creature that remains within 10 feet of the burner for at least 10 minutes. Before its next Long Rest, that creature has Advantage on one ability check made to meditate, interpret qi circulation, perform cultivation training, or stabilize an ordinary cultivation disturbance.
The burner does not grant CP, AP, a Sphere, a Talent, or an automatic breakthrough.

wondrous.construction: Twelve medicine-jade beads
wondrous.name: Twelve-Breath Recovery Beads
wondrous.text:
When you spend Hit Dice during a Short Rest, you can reroll one Hit Die and must use the new result.
The beads have 3 charges and regain all expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
As a Bonus Action, expend 1 charge to gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. These Temporary Hit Points last for 10 minutes.

wondrous.construction: Black mirror glass and clear-heart silver
wondrous.name: Heart-Demon Warning Mirror
wondrous.text:
The mirror clouds when you are affected by an illusion, possession attempt, dream intrusion, or effect that would impose the Charmed or Frightened condition. The warning does not reveal the source or prove that the effect is hostile.
Once per Long Rest, when you fail a saving throw against one of those effects, you can reroll the saving throw and must use the new result.

wondrous.construction: White jade and spirit-grain glaze
wondrous.name: Fasting Jade Cup
wondrous.text:
At dawn, the cup can transform ordinary potable water placed inside it into one serving of sustaining water.
A creature that drinks the serving requires no food and only half as much water for the next 24 hours.
The cup can create only one serving per dawn. The effect prevents hunger and thirst but does not remove existing Exhaustion or provide nourishment for growth, pregnancy, or intensive long-term training.

wondrous.construction: Moon jade and silver leaf
wondrous.name: Moon-Dew Collection Bowl
wondrous.text:
If left outdoors beneath the night sky for at least 6 hours, the bowl contains 1 pint of pure moon dew at dawn.
Moon dew functions as clean water and counts as an appropriate minor Water-, Yin-, Moon-, or purification-aligned ingredient worth **1 Spirit Shard**.
The bowl cannot produce dew underground, beneath an opaque roof, or during a night when the sky is completely sealed by a supernatural effect.

wondrous.construction: Sun copper and three fire-jade feet
wondrous.name: Alchemist's Steady-Flame Tripod
wondrous.text:
The tripod supplies stable low or medium heat without mundane fuel and supports vessels up to 100 pounds.
While using it with Alchemist's Supplies, you ignore penalties caused solely by wind, ordinary rain, unstable ground, or an inconsistent mundane heat source.
Once per Long Rest, when you fail an Alchemy check for a Common or Spiritual-grade product, reroll the check and use the new result.

wondrous.construction: Spirit iron and resonant bronze
wondrous.name: Blacksmith's Temper-Reading Hammer

wondrous.construction: Spirit thread marked with geometric jade beads
wondrous.name: Formation-Line Measuring Cord
wondrous.text:
The cord can extend from 1 foot to **300 feet** without changing weight.
When stretched between two visible points, it displays exact distance, slope, elevation difference, and cardinal direction.
You have Advantage on checks made to survey, copy, or repair a Common or Spiritual-grade formation layout using the cord. It does not locate hidden Formation Anchors by itself.

wondrous.construction: Black scholar jade and spirit-water channels
wondrous.name: Talisman Inkstone of Even Flow
wondrous.text:
At dawn, the inkstone produces enough ordinary black or red ink to write 20 pages.
Ink mixed in the stone does not dry for 8 hours and flows evenly despite ordinary heat, cold, or humidity.
Once per Long Rest, when you fail a check to inscribe a Mortal or Spiritual-grade talisman, reroll the check and use the new result.

wondrous.construction: Spirit steel and living wood handles
wondrous.name: Harvester's Clean-Cut Shears
wondrous.text:
You have Advantage on checks made to harvest herbs, flowers, vines, fungi, bark, fruit, or other nonhostile plant ingredients.
Harvesting time is halved when the shears are appropriate to the task.
A harvested plant ingredient remains at full freshness for 1 additional hour after cutting. The shears do not increase yield or permit harvesting a material above the creature's or site's available grade.

wondrous.construction: Spirit-beast bone, silver wire, and sealing jade
wondrous.name: Beast-Core Stabilizing Cage
wondrous.text:
The cage holds one beast core, monster organ, spiritual gland, or similarly dangerous harvested component weighing up to 20 pounds.
While closed, the component cannot leak ordinary poison, disease, elemental heat, cold, or hostile spiritual pressure beyond the cage.
You have Advantage on the first check made to stabilize, appraise, or begin refining the stored component after opening the cage.

wondrous.construction: Cloudwood and a spirit-silver eye
wondrous.name: Spirit-Thread Weaver's Shuttle
wondrous.text:
The shuttle can produce up to 30 feet of strong mundane thread each dawn.
When used with Weaver's Tools, it halves the time required to mend ordinary clothing, robes, tents, banners, or cloth armor.
Once per Long Rest, it can repair one tear or severed strap in a Spiritual Treasure made primarily from cloth, leather, or thread. This restores function but not expended charges or destroyed enchantments.

wondrous.construction: Source jade set into dark wood
wondrous.name: Source-Stone Sorting Tray
wondrous.text:
Place up to 10 pounds of stones, ore, crystals, or mineral fragments on the tray and spend 10 minutes sorting them.
The tray separates the contents into mundane waste, useful mundane material, spiritually active material, and sealed or unreadable material.
You have Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to appraise the sorted materials. The tray does not safely open sealed stones or identify a concealed creature.

wondrous.construction: River pearl and cleansing jade
wondrous.name: Clear-Water Purification Pearl
wondrous.text:
Place the pearl in a container holding up to **10 gallons** of water. After 1 minute, the water becomes clean and potable.
The pearl removes ordinary dirt, salt, rot, and nonmagical disease. It does not remove a magical poison, curse, alchemical reagent, or supernatural contamination.
The pearl can purify up to 30 gallons, after which it becomes inert until dawn.

wondrous.construction: Cloud silk, charcoal jade, and spirit filters
wondrous.name: Smoke-Breath Rescue Mask
wondrous.text:
While wearing the mask, you can breathe normally in nonmagical smoke, dust, ash, and ordinary irritating gas.
You have Advantage on saving throws against inhaled poison.
The mask contains 10 minutes of clean air for an airless or fully submerged environment. All wearers share this daily capacity, which refreshes at dawn.

wondrous.construction: White jade, folded talisman paper, and cloudwood
wondrous.name: One-Step Escape Talisman Box
wondrous.text:
The box has 3 charges and regains `1d3` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
When a creature you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your Reaction and expend 1 charge. After the attack resolves, move up to **10 feet** without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker.
This movement cannot pass through occupied spaces, Total Cover, or terrain you could not normally enter. It is movement, not teleportation.

wondrous.construction: Porcelain, hospitality jade, and spirit-silver trim
wondrous.name: Guest-Right Tea Service
wondrous.text:
The service prepares up to six cups of properly heated tea from supplied water and leaves.
Creatures that willingly share the tea during a 10-minute conversation can clearly understand one another's names, titles, and declared terms of hospitality despite an ordinary language barrier.
For 1 hour afterward, each participant has Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made to judge another participant's immediate emotional state. The service does not compel honesty or peace.

wondrous.construction: Red spirit thread and a blank jade bead
wondrous.name: Oath-Witness Red Cord
wondrous.text:
During a 10-minute ritual, up to two willing creatures hold the cord and speak an agreement of no more than 250 words.
The jade bead records the exact words, identities presented, date, and location. Any creature touching the bead can hear the recorded agreement.
If one participant knowingly performs an act directly prohibited by the recorded words, the bead darkens permanently. The cord does not prevent the act, determine ambiguous intent, or impose a curse.

wondrous.construction: Funeral jade and incense bronze
wondrous.name: Spirit-Calming Offering Bowl
wondrous.text:
Place food, incense, paper offerings, blood, flowers, or another culturally appropriate offering worth at least 1 Spirit Shard in the bowl.
For 1 hour, you have Advantage on Charisma checks made to communicate peacefully with a spirit, ghost, ancestor, or incorporeal Undead that willingly accepts or acknowledges the offering.
The bowl does not summon a spirit, bind it, force it to negotiate, or protect you from hostility.

wondrous.construction: Hollow jade and resonant bronze
wondrous.name: Hidden-Door Knocking Seal
wondrous.text:
The seal has 3 charges and regains all expended charges at dawn.
Press it against a solid surface and expend 1 charge as an Action. For 1 minute, it vibrates if a concealed door, hollow space, movable wall section, or artificial passage lies within 30 feet and is connected to the same structure.
The strength of the vibration indicates direction but not exact distance, opening method, traps, or contents.

wondrous.construction: Four jade crickets in a bamboo box
wondrous.name: Night-Watch Alarm Crickets
wondrous.text:
The set contains four crickets. As a 1-minute procedure, place them to define a perimeter no larger than a 30-foot-radius area.
For up to 8 hours, a cricket chirps loudly when a Tiny or larger creature crosses the perimeter without speaking a password chosen during setup. A creature can notice a cricket with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Perception) check.
The crickets do not detect teleportation, incorporeal movement through the ground, or a creature already inside the perimeter when activated.

wondrous.construction: Sun copper, warm jade, and spirit glass
wondrous.name: Lantern of Emberless Heat
wondrous.text:
The lantern sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. It produces warmth but no flame, smoke, or fuel consumption.
As an Action, you can change the light to one of three settings: full light, dim ember-light, or heat only.
While the heat setting is active, creatures within 10 feet have Advantage on saving throws against ordinary extreme cold. The lantern cannot ignite objects or deal damage.

wondrous.construction: Blue roof tile, river jade, and cloud ink
wondrous.name: Rain-Calling Travel Tile
wondrous.text:
The tile has 1 charge and regains it at dawn.
As a 10-minute ritual outdoors, expend the charge to gather a light natural rain over a 100-foot-radius area for 10 minutes. The effect fails beneath a sealed roof, underground without a natural opening, or in an environment where liquid water cannot exist.
The rain extinguishes ordinary Tiny flames, fills open containers with clean rainwater, and grants Advantage on checks made to conceal tracks by washing away dust or loose soil. It does not create a storm or overcome magical fire.

wondrous.construction: Eight spirit-bamboo stakes with hush-thread
wondrous.name: Quiet-Camp Boundary Stakes
wondrous.text:
The set contains eight stakes. As a 10-minute procedure, place them to define a perimeter no larger than a 30-foot-radius area.
For up to 8 hours, ordinary sound originating inside the perimeter is muffled beyond its edge. A creature outside has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing to notice activity inside.
The stakes do not block sound entering the area, magical sound, thunder damage, or deliberate shouting from outside the boundary.

wondrous.construction: Lacquered horn box and spirit-beast musk crystals
wondrous.name: Beast-Scent Trail Powder Box
wondrous.text:
The box produces three doses of tracking powder at dawn.
As an Action, scatter one dose over a footprint, hair, bloodstain, shed scale, or similar physical trace left within the previous 24 hours.
For 1 hour, the powder glows faintly whenever placed within 10 feet of a newer trace left by the same creature. A creature using the powder has Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to follow that trail.
The powder cannot track a creature that leaves no physical traces or has crossed to another plane.

wondrous.construction: Spirit bronze and hearth jade
wondrous.name: Shared-Meal Warming Pot
wondrous.text:
The pot can prepare or warm enough ordinary food for up to eight creatures without fuel.
A creature that eats a full meal from the pot during a Short Rest can reroll one Hit Die spent during that rest and must use the new result.
Only three creatures can gain this reroll from the pot between Long Rests. The pot does not create ingredients or make spoiled food safe.

wondrous.construction: Black bamboo and wind-horse hair
wondrous.name: Footprint-Erasing Brush
wondrous.text:
As an Action, sweep the brush over a 5-foot square of ground.
The brush removes ordinary footprints, drag marks, wheel ruts, blood drops, ash trails, and similar mundane traces in that square. It cannot erase structural damage, magical marks, scent, memories, or evidence protected by a stronger supernatural effect.
During overland travel, one creature using the brush can conceal the tracks of up to six travelers moving at a slow pace.

wondrous.construction: Moon bamboo and pale spirit silk
wondrous.name: Spirit-Moth Message Cage
wondrous.text:
The cage houses one harmless spirit moth. At dawn, it reforms inside the cage if it was previously released.
As an Action, speak a message of no more than 50 words and name a creature you know within 5 miles on the same plane. The moth flies toward that creature at a Speed of 60 feet.
If it reaches the creature within 1 hour, it delivers the message in your voice and then returns to the cage. Total Cover does not block its route, but sealed barriers, dimensional wards, and hostile capture can stop it.

wondrous.construction: Spirit reed and moon-silver keys
wondrous.name: Borrowed-Voice Reed Flute
wondrous.text:
During a 1-minute listening ritual, choose one willing creature that speaks or sings within 10 feet. The flute stores that creature's voice until you store another.
While playing the flute, you can speak or sing using the stored voice. A creature that hears you can discern the imitation with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check against your item save DC.
The flute reproduces voice only. It does not grant languages, memories, command authority, or identity-based supernatural access.

wondrous.construction: Twelve spirit-iron nails marked with geometric grooves
wondrous.name: Minor Formation Anchor Nails
wondrous.text:
The set contains twelve nails.
When used during a Formation project, the nails can stabilize one Common or Spiritual-grade Formation Anchor placed in ordinary soil, wood, or masonry.
A formation using at least four nails gains Advantage on one check made to resist ordinary wind, flooding, shaking ground, accidental movement, or structural vibration.
The nails do not create a formation, increase its save DC, or stabilize Saint-grade or stronger effects.

wondrous.construction: Sun jade and engraved bronze
wondrous.name: Sun-Dial of Honest Hours
wondrous.text:
The dial always displays the local solar time while exposed to natural daylight or moonlight. Underground or beneath a sealed roof, it continues to track time for 7 days before losing accuracy.
As a 1-minute procedure, you can learn how much time has passed since the dial last saw natural sky.
The dial cannot predict the future, measure altered planar time, or function inside an effect that completely suspends time.

wondrous.construction: Blue cord, shell beads, and river jade
wondrous.name: Salt-Warding Sailor's Knot
wondrous.text:
When tied to a boat, raft, pack, or carried cargo bundle, the knot protects that object and its secured contents from ordinary salt corrosion, mildew, and waterlogging.
A vessel carrying the knot has Advantage on checks made to resist ordinary waves, currents, or storms that would swamp it.
The knot does not protect against magical water, siege damage, capsizing caused by creatures, or a storm created by a cultivation technique.

wondrous.construction: Purified silver and medicine jade
wondrous.name: Poison-Tasting Silver Cicada
wondrous.text:
Place the cicada beside one serving of food, drink, medicine, incense, or alchemical powder and wait 1 minute.
The cicada chirps if the sample contains a poison, disease, spoiled ingredient, or harmful alchemical contaminant detectable at Spiritual grade or lower.
It reveals the presence and broad category of the danger, not its exact identity, save DC, dose, or magical origin. A deliberately concealed Saint-grade or stronger poison can evade the cicada.

wondrous.construction: Moon silk and silver ink
wondrous.name: Moonlit Map Cloth
wondrous.text:
Spread the cloth beneath moonlight or starlight for 1 minute.
It displays a map of terrain you have personally traveled through within the previous 7 days, covering an area up to 10 miles across. The map includes major roads, rivers, buildings, elevations, and named landmarks you consciously noticed.
It does not reveal hidden locations, interiors you did not enter, creatures, traps, or changes that occurred after you left.

wondrous.construction: Sect jade and identity-thread inscription
wondrous.name: Sect-Rank Recognition Token
wondrous.text:
When attuned by an authorized member, the token displays the bearer's registered name, sect, office, and rank.
A matching sect formation or official reader can verify whether the token is genuine and whether its bearer is the attuned member.
The token does not grant rank or access by itself. If the Attunement ends, the displayed identity fades until the token is properly reassigned by the issuing authority.

wondrous.construction: Spirit wood, moon silver, and soft beast bristles
wondrous.name: Spirit-Companion Grooming Comb
wondrous.text:
During a Short Rest, use the comb on one willing Beast, spirit companion, or bonded creature.
The creature can immediately repeat one saving throw against the Charmed or Frightened condition if the effect normally permits repeated saves.
It also has Advantage on the next Wisdom (Perception) or Charisma check it makes before its next Long Rest.
A creature can benefit from the comb only once per Long Rest.

wondrous.construction: Plain clay glazed with clear spirit lacquer
wondrous.name: Empty-Bowl Beggar's Cup
wondrous.text:
At dawn, the cup can produce one simple serving of rice porridge and clean water if it was freely given to a hungry creature during the previous day.
A creature that consumes the serving gains enough nourishment for 24 hours and has Advantage on the next saving throw it makes against Exhaustion caused by starvation or thirst.
The cup cannot produce food through sale, coercion, theft, or self-serving exchange.

wondrous.construction: Frost jade stamp and blue sealing wax
wondrous.name: Frost-Locking Food Seal
wondrous.text:
As an Action, press the seal onto a closed container holding no more than 50 pounds of nonliving food or drink.
For 30 days, the contents remain fresh, cool, and protected from ordinary spoilage, insects, and mold. Opening the container ends the effect.
The seal can maintain three containers at a time. Sealing a fourth ends the oldest seal.

wondrous.construction: A reusable jade incense stick and sandalwood core
wondrous.name: Incense of Calm Negotiation
wondrous.text:
As an Action, light the incense. It burns for 10 minutes and fills a 10-foot-radius area with a mild scent.
Creatures that willingly remain in the area for at least 1 minute have Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks and Charisma (Persuasion) checks made during that conversation.
The incense does not affect a hostile creature that refuses to negotiate, does not suppress combat, and cannot force honesty or agreement. It can be used once and refreshes at dawn.

wondrous.construction: Dark jade links and folded-space silk
wondrous.name: Hidden-Pocket Jade Belt
wondrous.text:
The belt contains six extradimensional pockets. Each pocket holds up to 5 pounds or one hand-held object.
A creature searching you has Disadvantage on checks made to find stored objects unless it knows the belt's command word.
You can retrieve one stored object as part of the same object interaction used to draw it. The pockets cannot hold creatures, active flames, or extradimensional containers.

wondrous.construction: Waxed cloud silk and sealing thread
wondrous.name: Rainproof Scripture Wrap
wondrous.text:
The wrap holds one book, scroll bundle, jade-slip case, or document stack no larger than 10 pounds.
Contents are protected from ordinary water, rain, snow, smoke, dust, and accidental ink smearing.
If the wrapped object is exposed to magical water, fire, acid, or a destructive talisman effect, it has Resistance to that damage while the wrap remains intact.

wondrous.construction: Purified copper and cleansing jade
wondrous.name: Wound-Cleansing Copper Basin
wondrous.text:
Fill the basin with 1 gallon of clean water and spend 10 minutes washing one willing creature's wounds.
The creature can immediately repeat one saving throw against a nonmagical poison or disease if the effect normally allows repeated saves.
It also gains Advantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes before its next Long Rest against infection, poison, or disease caused by an open wound.
The basin can be used once and refreshes at dawn.

wondrous.construction: Funeral bronze and pale spirit glass
wondrous.name: Lantern of Safe Burial
wondrous.text:
When placed beside a corpse and lit for 10 minutes, the lantern protects that corpse for 24 hours.
During that time, ordinary decay is halted, the corpse cannot rise as an ordinary Undead, and hostile spirits have Disadvantage on checks made to possess or animate it.
The lantern does not imprison the soul, prevent resurrection, or stop a Saint-grade or stronger necromantic effect without an opposed check set by the GM.

wondrous.construction: Resonant cavern stone and silver wire
wondrous.name: Echo-Finding Cavern Pebble
wondrous.text:
As an Action, strike the pebble against a solid surface.
For 1 minute, it vibrates in the direction of the nearest open passage, chamber, shaft, or hollow space within 60 feet that is connected through stone, earth, or masonry.
It cannot distinguish a natural cave from a constructed room and does not reveal contents, hazards, or sealed extradimensional spaces.

wondrous.construction: White wax, scholar jade, and a smokeless wick
wondrous.name: Windless Candle of Study
wondrous.text:
The candle burns without smoke and cannot be extinguished by ordinary wind or rain.
A creature studying, copying, translating, or analyzing text within 10 feet of the candle has Advantage on checks made solely to maintain concentration despite ordinary noise, weather, or discomfort.
The candle burns for 8 hours and regains all expended duration at dawn.

wondrous.construction: Endless spirit cord and knot jade
wondrous.name: Ten-Thousand Knot Repair Cord
wondrous.text:
The cord can extend to 100 feet and retract to 1 foot as an Object Interaction.
During a Short Rest, it can repair one nonmagical rope, strap, harness, net, tent, sail, pack, or cloth object whose missing material totals no more than 10 feet.
As an Action, it can bind a closed container or door. Breaking the cord requires a DC 15 Strength check. Once broken, it reforms at dawn.

wondrous.construction: Peachwood plaque and red sealing cord
wondrous.name: Sleep-Guarding Door Charm
wondrous.text:
Hang the charm on a door, tent flap, window, or other entrance no wider than 10 feet.
For up to 8 hours, the charm emits a clear tone if the entrance is opened or crossed by a creature that did not speak the password chosen during setup.
Creatures completing a Long Rest within 30 feet have Advantage on saving throws against ordinary nightmares and dream intrusion of Spiritual grade or lower.

wondrous.construction: Spirit bronze and beast-bone clappers
wondrous.name: Spirit-Beast Calming Chime
wondrous.text:
As an Action, ring the chime. Each Beast, Monstrosity with Intelligence 5 or lower, or willing spirit companion within 20 feet that can hear it becomes calm until the start of your next turn.
A hostile creature must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or cannot take Reactions and has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the effect ends.
After a creature succeeds on this save, it is immune to the chime until dawn.

wondrous.construction: River jade and weighted spirit wood
wondrous.name: River-Current Measuring Float
wondrous.text:
Place the float on a liquid surface and observe it for 1 minute.
You learn the current's direction, approximate speed, depth category, whether it is naturally or supernaturally disturbed, and whether a strong undertow or hidden drop lies within 100 feet downstream.
The float does not detect creatures, poison, portals, or hazards that do not alter the water's movement.

wondrous.construction: Balanced spirit bronze and source-jade weights
wondrous.name: False-Gold Revealing Scale
wondrous.text:
Place up to 10 pounds of coins, metal, ore, jewelry, or trade bars on the scale and spend 1 minute weighing them.
The scale reveals approximate purity, total ordinary market weight, and whether the sample contains mundane plating, filler, or counterfeit alloy.
It does not identify supernatural enchantments, ownership, historical value, or a sophisticated Saint-grade forgery.

wondrous.construction: Clear bronze and breath jade
wondrous.name: Breath-Counting Meditation Bell
wondrous.text:
The bell sounds softly at intervals matching the user's breathing while held during meditation.
A creature using it for at least 10 minutes has Advantage on the next ability check made before its next Long Rest to control breathing, resist suffocation, steady qi circulation, or maintain a mantra under stress.
A creature can gain this benefit only once per Long Rest.

wondrous.construction: Mountain-root jade engraved with weight inscriptions
wondrous.name: Mountain-Root Suppression Seal
wondrous.text:
The seal has 5 charges and regains `1d4 + 1` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
**Suppress.** As an Action, expend 1 charge and choose one creature or unattended object you can see within 60 feet. A creature makes a Strength saving throw against your item save DC.
On a failed save, its Speed becomes 0 and it cannot be moved by its own teleportation until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until then.
An unattended object weighing no more than 5,000 pounds becomes fixed in place until the start of your next turn.

wondrous.construction: Five spirit-beast feathers mounted in storm bamboo
wondrous.name: Five-Feather Calamity Fan
wondrous.text:
The fan has 5 charges and regains `1d4 + 1` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
As an Action, expend 1 charge and choose one effect:
- **Cinder Wind:** 30-foot cone; Dexterity save; `4d6` fire damage, half on success.
- **Frost Gust:** 30-foot cone; Constitution save; `3d6` cold damage and Speed reduced by 10 feet until your next turn, half damage only on success.
- **Thunder Feather:** One creature within 60 feet; ranged item attack; `4d8` lightning damage on a hit.
- **Clearing Wind:** Disperse non-Imperial smoke, fog, gas, or airborne debris in a 30-foot-radius sphere within 60 feet.
- **Sky Lift:** Move one willing creature within 30 feet up to 30 feet through the air to an unoccupied space.

wondrous.construction: Ancient heartwood, soul jade, and force inscriptions
wondrous.name: God-Striking Heartwood Rod
wondrous.text:
The rod has 5 charges and regains `1d4 + 1` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
As an Action, expend 1 charge and make a melee item attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes `4d8` force damage.
