If the target is a Construct, Undead, incorporeal spirit, summoned creature, or possessing entity, it takes an additional `2d8` psychic damage and must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your item save DC or be unable to take Reactions until the start of your next turn.

wondrous.construction: Moon silk woven with mirror-sea silver thread
wondrous.name: Moon-Mirror Stillwater Mantle
wondrous.text:
You have Advantage on saving throws against visual illusions and gaze effects.
The mantle has 3 charges and regains `1d3` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
**Stillwater Reflection.** When a creature you can see targets you with an attack, you can use your Reaction and expend 1 charge to impose Disadvantage on that attack. If the attack misses, you become Invisible until the start of your next turn or until you make an attack, deal damage, or force a saving throw.

wondrous.construction: Thunder jade, gold talisman ink, and folded space paper
wondrous.name: Thunder-Script Escape Talisman
wondrous.text:
The talisman has 3 charges and regains 1 expended charge when you complete a Long Rest.
When you take damage, you can use your Reaction and expend 1 charge to teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see after the damage resolves.
Creatures within 5 feet of the space you left must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your item save DC or take `2d8` lightning damage.
The talisman cannot cross a sealed dimensional boundary.

wondrous.construction: Nine-fold void crystal set in spirit gold
wondrous.name: Nine-Lock Storage Ring
wondrous.text:
The ring contains nine separate extradimensional chambers. Each chamber holds up to **500 pounds or 32 cubic feet**.
As an Action, store one unattended object that fits through a 5-foot-wide opening. As a Bonus Action, retrieve one hand-held object from a known chamber; larger objects require an Action.
Each chamber can be individually locked. Opening a locked chamber without Attunement requires a successful DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check made during a 10-minute ritual.
Living creatures are immediately expelled and take `4d6` force damage. Nesting extradimensional spaces destroys the inserted container and scatters its contents within 300 feet.

wondrous.construction: Beast-hide bag lined with verdant space silk
wondrous.name: Hundred-Beast Holding Bag
wondrous.text:
The bag contains a stable extradimensional meadow suitable for up to **ten willing Beasts or bonded companions**, each Large or smaller.
A creature enters or leaves as an Action while touching the open bag. An unwilling creature cannot be placed inside.
Creatures inside have breathable air, water, and ordinary forage but do not complete Short or Long Rests there unless the bag remains stationary and open for the full rest.
If the bag is destroyed, occupants appear Prone in the nearest unoccupied spaces and take `4d6` force damage.

wondrous.construction: Cloudwood model pavilion and sky jade
wondrous.name: Cloud Palace Travel Pavilion
wondrous.text:
As a 10-minute ritual, place the model on open ground. It expands into a furnished pavilion occupying a 30-foot square and standing 20 feet high.
The pavilion contains sleeping space for twelve creatures, a kitchen, a meeting room, and protected storage for 2,000 pounds of ordinary cargo.
It lasts until dismissed with a 10-minute ritual. While expanded, it cannot move and is an object with AC 17 and 150 Hit Points.
If destroyed, creatures are expelled safely, and stored objects spill into adjacent spaces. The pavilion reforms after 7 days.

wondrous.construction: River jade basin and spirit-spring core
wondrous.name: Spirit-Spring Bathing Basin
wondrous.text:
When filled with at least 20 gallons of clean water, the basin creates a warm medicinal bath lasting 1 hour.
Up to four creatures can benefit during that hour. A creature that bathes for at least 30 minutes can spend Hit Dice as though completing a Short Rest and can immediately repeat one saving throw against a poison, disease, or Exhaustion effect that permits repeated saves.
The basin can be activated once and refreshes at dawn.

wondrous.construction: Jade gourd, furnace-gold veins, and medicine seals
wondrous.name: Pill-Refining Jade Gourd
wondrous.text:
The gourd functions as a portable Saint-grade alchemical furnace and can hold up to 50 completed pills without loss of potency.
When used to refine a Mortal, Spiritual, or Saint-grade pill, you gain a +2 bonus to the Alchemy check.
Once per Long Rest, when such a check fails by 5 or less, you can convert the result into a Broken product instead of losing all ingredients.
The gourd does not create ingredients or bypass recipe access.

wondrous.construction: Source jade, star iron, and a suspended silver needle
wondrous.name: Source-Heaven Compass
wondrous.text:
As a 10-minute ritual, place the compass on natural stone or soil.
You learn the direction, approximate depth, and broad grade of the strongest mineral deposit, spirit-stone vein, sealed stone, buried chamber, or major geomantic disturbance within 1 mile.
The compass distinguishes natural, constructed, sealed, and living sources but does not identify contents or safely open them.
A Sovereign or stronger concealment effect can produce no reading rather than a false one.

wondrous.construction: Mirror-sea silver and paired space jade
wondrous.name: Thousand-Li Communication Mirror
wondrous.text:
The treasure consists of two matched mirrors.
Once per Long Rest, a bearer can use an Action to call the paired mirror while both are on the same plane and within 1,000 miles.
If the other bearer accepts as a Reaction, the mirrors transmit sight and sound between them for up to 10 minutes. Each mirror shows only what lies directly before the other.
Sealed communication barriers, planar separation, or a stronger Space effect can prevent the connection.

wondrous.construction: Dream crystal, moon bronze, and pale flame
wondrous.name: Dream-Path Lantern
wondrous.text:
While the lantern burns within 10 feet of you, you have Advantage on saving throws against dream intrusion, magical sleep, and nightmare effects.
Once per Long Rest, two willing creatures that complete a Long Rest within 10 feet of the lantern can enter a shared symbolic dream for up to 1 hour of subjective time.
They can converse and exchange remembered images but cannot carry objects, suffer physical damage, or learn information neither participant knows.

wondrous.construction: Funeral jade, ancestor bronze, and name-tablet slots
wondrous.name: Ancestor-Questioning Incense Burner
wondrous.text:
Once per Long Rest, burn incense worth 1 Low-Grade Spirit Stone while presenting a true name, blood relation, personal relic, or funerary tablet connected to a deceased ancestor.
After 10 minutes, ask up to three questions aloud. If the ancestor's spirit remains reachable and willing, the burner produces brief answers through smoke, sound, or written ash.
The answers reflect the ancestor's knowledge and perspective. The burner cannot compel a spirit, contact a destroyed soul, or guarantee objective truth.

wondrous.construction: Rotating jade rings and spirit-bronze sighting arms
wondrous.name: Formation-Breaking Surveyor's Compass
wondrous.text:
While holding the compass, you can perceive visible Formation Anchors and active formation lines within 60 feet as faint geometric light.
As an Action, choose one non-Imperial Formation Anchor you can see within range and make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against the formation's save DC.
On a success, you learn one of the following: its function, power source, linked anchors, current weakness, or the safest method to suppress it.
On a success by 5 or more, the next check or attack made against that anchor before the end of your next turn has Advantage.

wondrous.construction: Star silver, night jade, and rotating celestial rings
wondrous.name: Star-Position Astrolabe
wondrous.text:
The astrolabe functions under open sky, through ordinary clouds, and during daylight.
It always reveals your latitude-equivalent position, cardinal direction, local time, and whether you are on the same plane where it was created.
Once per Long Rest, spend 10 minutes observing the astrolabe to gain Advantage on one Wisdom (Survival), Intelligence (History), or Intelligence (Arcana) check made within 24 hours to navigate, interpret a celestial omen, or identify planar displacement.

wondrous.construction: Red-gold balance arms and black-white jade pans
wondrous.name: Karma-Weight Measuring Scale
wondrous.text:
As a 10-minute ritual, place a personal object, written oath, payment, gift, or symbolic offering on one pan while a willing creature touches the other.
You learn whether the creature currently believes accepting or fulfilling the represented exchange would create a minor, significant, or severe personal obligation.
The scale reads the creature's sincere sense of debt and consequence, not objective cosmic law. A creature can conceal its reading with a successful Charisma saving throw against your item save DC.

wondrous.construction: Court jade, red-gold ink channels, and witness bronze
wondrous.name: Oath-Binding Court Seal
wondrous.text:
During a 10-minute ritual, up to six willing creatures sign or mark a written agreement of no more than 1,000 words.
For 30 days, each signer knows when it knowingly violates a direct, unambiguous prohibition in the agreement and takes `3d6` psychic damage immediately after the violation.
A signer can suffer this damage only once per day. The seal does not compel obedience, interpret ambiguous wording, or punish an act the signer sincerely believed was permitted.
A remove-curse-equivalent effect or stronger Karma technique can end a creature's bond.

wondrous.construction: Blood jade, mirror silver, and ancestral ink
wondrous.name: Bloodline Recognition Mirror
wondrous.text:
A creature places one drop of blood on the mirror and waits 1 minute.
The mirror reveals whether the sample shares a direct bloodline connection with another stored sample, one known lineage entered into the mirror, or a willing creature touching the frame.
It reports no relation, distant relation, close relation, or direct parent-child relation. It does not reveal identity, legitimacy, inheritance rights, race, or exact genealogy.
The mirror can store twelve reference samples at a time.

wondrous.construction: Soul jade case with nine moon-silver needles
wondrous.name: Soul-Wound Mending Needle Case
wondrous.text:
The case has 5 charges and regains `1d4 + 1` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
As an Action, touch one willing creature and expend 1 charge. The target regains `3d8 + your Proficiency Bonus` Hit Points and can immediately repeat one saving throw against possession, Charmed, Frightened, or a spirit-inflicted condition that permits repeated saves.
Alternatively, expend 2 charges during a 10-minute procedure to end one minor spiritual injury, nightmare residue, possession aftereffect, or soul scar of Saint grade or lower, subject to GM adjudication.

wondrous.construction: Phoenix feather, sun copper, and renewal jade
wondrous.name: Phoenix-Feather Rescue Fan
wondrous.text:
The fan has 5 charges and regains `1d4 + 1` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
**Rescue Wind.** When a creature you can see within 60 feet would drop to 0 Hit Points but not die outright, you can use your Reaction and expend 2 charges. The creature drops to 1 Hit Point instead and can move up to 20 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
**Rekindling Gust.** As an Action, expend 1 charge. One willing creature within 30 feet regains `3d8 + your Proficiency Bonus` Hit Points.
A creature can benefit from Rescue Wind only once per Long Rest.

wondrous.construction: Abyssal pearl, deepsea cold iron, and river jade
wondrous.name: Deep-Sea Breathing Pearl
wondrous.text:
While the pearl is on your person, you can breathe air and water, gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed, and suffer no harm from ordinary deep-water pressure.
You can speak normally underwater, though only creatures able to hear through water understand you.
The pearl has 3 charges and regains all expended charges at dawn. As an Action, expend 1 charge to grant these benefits to up to six willing creatures within 10 feet for 1 hour.

wondrous.construction: Mountain jade, folded-space stone, and black iron
wondrous.name: Mountain-Bearing Travel Pagoda
wondrous.text:
The palm-sized pagoda contains an extradimensional cargo hall holding up to **20,000 pounds or 2,000 cubic feet** of nonliving material.
An unattended object no larger than a 10-foot cube can be stored or retrieved as an Action while touching the pagoda. A creature cannot enter the hall.
As a 10-minute ritual, expand the pagoda into a 20-foot-square stone shelter. While expanded, stored cargo can be accessed through its doors, and up to twelve creatures can shelter inside the ordinary room. The extradimensional cargo hall remains inaccessible to creatures.
If destroyed, stored cargo appears in the nearest unoccupied spaces without taking damage.

wondrous.construction: Cloudwood carved around a wind-crystal heart
wondrous.name: Cloud-Riding Crane Carving
wondrous.text:
As an Action, place the carving in an unoccupied space within 10 feet. It becomes a Large cloud crane with AC 17, 60 Hit Points, a walking Speed of 20 feet, and a Fly Speed of 80 feet.
The crane can carry up to four Medium creatures and 500 pounds of cargo. It understands your languages and obeys your spoken directions but cannot attack.
The crane remains for up to 8 hours, until reduced to 0 Hit Points, or until dismissed as a Bonus Action. It then returns to carving form. If reduced to 0 Hit Points, it cannot transform again until 7 days have passed.

wondrous.construction: Two matched cloudwood screens painted with wind paths
wondrous.name: Wind-Gate Folding Screen
wondrous.text:
The treasure consists of two folding screens.
After each screen has remained open and stationary for 10 minutes, they form a linked passage while on the same plane and within 10 miles.
A willing creature can use an Action to step through one screen and emerge from the other in the nearest unoccupied space. A creature larger than Large cannot pass through.
The passage transports up to twenty creatures or 5,000 pounds of unattended objects between Long Rests. Moving, closing, damaging, or separating either screen ends the link.

wondrous.construction: Black jade, city-map silk, and concealed-path inscriptions
wondrous.name: Hidden-City Map Case
wondrous.text:
The case can store up to one hundred maps without increasing its 3-pound weight.
During a Long Rest in a settlement, the case records public roads, gates, bridges, major districts, government buildings, markets, inns, temples, and other locations you personally visit or can see from a public place.
As an Action, name one recorded destination in the current settlement. The case displays the shortest publicly accessible route and estimates ordinary travel time.
The case does not reveal secret passages, hidden organizations, private interiors, patrol schedules, or changes made after the map was recorded.

wondrous.construction: Beast-core bronze, verdant jade, and bloodline seals
wondrous.name: Spirit-Beast Evolution Cauldron

wondrous.construction: World-seed wood, river jade, and fertile spirit soil
wondrous.name: Verdant Garden Seed Box
wondrous.text:
The box contains a stable 60-foot-square garden with twelve cultivation plots.
A willing creature can enter or leave as an Action while touching the open box. The garden has breathable air, clean water, and ordinary daylight, but it cannot support a Long Rest unless the box remains stationary and open for the full rest.
Plants grow at **four times** their normal rate. The garden can safely cultivate Mortal, Spiritual, and Saint-grade plants when proper seeds, soil, and care are supplied.
It cannot hold animals larger than Tiny, create ingredients, or grow Sovereign-grade plants.

wondrous.construction: Black jade, ghost iron, and preservation seals
wondrous.name: Corpse-Preservation Black Jade Coffin
wondrous.text:
The coffin holds one Medium or smaller corpse, or the equivalent remains of a larger creature.
A corpse sealed inside does not decay for **one year**, cannot rise as an Undead of Saint grade or lower, and cannot be possessed through the coffin.
A creature attempting to locate, animate, or communicate with the corpse through a supernatural effect must succeed on an ability check against DC 17.
Opening the coffin suspends these protections until it is closed and sealed again during a 10-minute ritual.

wondrous.construction: Funeral bronze, soul jade, and a white flame
wondrous.name: Soul-Sheltering Funeral Lamp
wondrous.text:
When a willing creature dies within 30 feet, you can use your Reaction to invite its departing soul into the lamp. An unwilling soul cannot be captured.
The soul can remain for up to 7 days. During that time, the corpse cannot rise as an Undead unless the soul consents, and effects that restore the creature to life treat the soul as present.
Once per day, the soul can speak through the flame for up to 10 minutes. It retains its knowledge and personality but cannot perceive beyond the lamp's space unless shown something directly.
The soul can leave at any time and departs automatically when restored to life.

wondrous.construction: Resonant wood, silver cylinders, and memory crystal
wondrous.name: Thousand-Voice Music Box
wondrous.text:
The box stores up to one thousand recordings, each lasting no more than 1 hour.
As an Action, begin or end a recording of audible sound within 60 feet. As an Action, replay one recording at its original volume or any quieter volume.
The box can reproduce layered performances, spoken testimony, animal calls, environmental sound, and command phrases, but it does not reproduce supernatural effects carried by a voice.
You have Advantage on checks made to compare a current voice or sound to a stored recording.

wondrous.construction: One hundred linked jade slips and a soul-silver frame
wondrous.name: Memory-Sealing Jade Archive
wondrous.text:
A willing creature can spend 10 minutes touching the archive to copy one memory lasting no more than 1 hour. Copying does not remove or alter the original memory.
The archive stores up to one hundred memories. A creature touching it can replay one memory during an equal amount of real time, experiencing the contributor's recorded senses and emotions.
A contributor can seal its memory behind a command phrase or named list of permitted viewers. Opening a sealed memory without permission requires a successful DC 18 Intelligence (Arcana) check during a 1-hour ritual.
The archive records subjective memory, not objective truth.

wondrous.construction: Black-white mirror glass and court jade
wondrous.name: Truth-and-Falsehood Dividing Mirror
wondrous.text:
The mirror has 5 charges and regains `1d4 + 1` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
After a creature visible in the mirror makes a factual statement of no more than 100 words, you can expend 1 charge as a Reaction. An unwilling speaker makes a Charisma saving throw against your item save DC.
On a failed save, the mirror displays:
- **white** if the speaker sincerely believes the statement is substantially true;
- **black** if the speaker knowingly makes a substantially false statement;
- **divided** if the speaker mixes believed truth with deliberate falsehood.
On a successful save, the mirror clouds. It does not identify omissions, objective truth, prophecy, or magically altered beliefs.

wondrous.construction: Medicine jade, purified silver, and black-glass seals
wondrous.name: Poison-Absorbing Medicine Jar
wondrous.text:
The jar has 7 charges and regains `1d6 + 1` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
**Purify Substance.** As an Action, expend 1 charge to remove one poison of Saint grade or lower from up to 1 gallon of food, drink, or medicine placed inside.
**Draw Poison.** During a 1-minute procedure, expend 2 charges while touching a willing creature. End the Poisoned condition caused by one poison of Saint grade or lower.
The removed poison is condensed into a sealed dose inside the jar. The jar can hold three doses. Removing a dose safely requires Alchemist's Supplies and a successful DC 15 Intelligence check.

wondrous.construction: Five-phase bronze, spirit ceramic, and hearth jade
wondrous.name: Five-Flavor Banquet Cauldron
wondrous.text:
Given ordinary ingredients for at least twenty meals, the cauldron prepares a complete banquet during a 1-hour ritual.
Choose one banquet effect. A creature that eats for at least 10 minutes gains the chosen benefit until its next Long Rest:
- **Bitter:** Advantage on saving throws against poison and disease.
- **Sweet:** Temporary Hit Points equal to twice its Proficiency Bonus.
- **Sour:** Advantage on initiative rolls.
- **Spicy:** Speed increases by 5 feet.
- **Savory:** It can reroll one Hit Die spent during a Short Rest.
A creature can benefit from only one Five-Flavor banquet per Long Rest.

wondrous.construction: Medicine jade, river silver, and meridian inscriptions
wondrous.name: Clean-Meridian Tea Kettle
wondrous.text:
The kettle prepares six servings of meridian-clearing tea during a Short or Long Rest using herbs worth 1 Mid-Grade Spirit Stone.
A creature can drink one serving during that rest to regain expended CP, Stamina, or Resonance equal to its Proficiency Bonus.
A creature can benefit from the kettle only once per Long Rest.
For 1 hour after drinking, the creature has Advantage on saving throws against effects that would prevent it from spending its Path resource or that would corrupt its circulation.

wondrous.construction: Formation silk, spirit-iron pole, and source-jade finial
wondrous.name: Formation-Linked Camp Banner

wondrous.construction: Storm iron, grounding jade, and a 30-foot bronze mast
wondrous.name: Lightning-Rod Sect Spire
wondrous.text:
The spire requires 1 hour to install and protects a 300-foot-radius area.
Natural lightning and uncontrolled Spiritual- or Saint-grade lightning effects striking the protected area are drawn to the spire when possible. Creatures and structures in the area have Resistance to lightning damage.
The spire stores up to 5 Lightning charges. Whenever it prevents or reduces at least 20 lightning damage, it gains 1 charge.
An adjacent formation or crafting installation can expend 1 stored charge to replace 1 Mid-Grade Spirit Stone of lightning-aligned power. Unused charges dissipate after 7 days.

wondrous.construction: A matched pair of ghost-iron and white-jade lion statues
wondrous.name: Ghost-Warding Gate Lions
wondrous.text:
Place the two lions on opposite sides of an entrance no wider than 30 feet. After 1 hour, they create a ward extending through that entrance.
An Undead, incorporeal spirit, or possessing entity attempting to cross must make a Charisma saving throw against DC 17.
On a failed save, it cannot cross for 1 hour and takes `4d8` radiant damage. On a successful save, it crosses but causes both lions to roar audibly out to 300 feet.
The ward does not affect a creature openly invited by the owner during setup.

wondrous.construction: Moon silver, clear jade, and a central eye crystal
wondrous.name: Illusion-Piercing Third-Eye Circlet
wondrous.text:
You have Advantage on saving throws against illusions and on Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to discern them.
The circlet has 5 charges and regains `1d4 + 1` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
As a Bonus Action, expend 1 charge to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:
- see Invisible creatures and objects within 30 feet;
- perceive visual illusions as translucent;
- see active talisman lines, Formation Anchors, and possession marks within 30 feet.
Total Cover blocks this sight.

wondrous.construction: Shadow hide, moon-silver buckles, and void-thread soles
wondrous.name: Hidden-Step Shadow Boots
wondrous.text:
Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you are in Dim Light or Darkness.
The boots have 5 charges and regain `1d4 + 1` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
As a Bonus Action while in Dim Light or Darkness, expend 1 charge to teleport up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in Dim Light or Darkness.
After teleporting, you have Advantage on the next Dexterity (Stealth) check you make before the end of the turn.

wondrous.construction: Eight black-iron rings engraved with adjustable weight seals
wondrous.name: Gravity-Training Iron Rings
wondrous.text:
The set contains eight rings worn on the wrists, ankles, waist, and shoulders.
As an Action, set the rings to one of three training loads: light, heavy, or crushing.
- **Light:** No penalty; you have Advantage on checks made during structured physical training.
- **Heavy:** Speed is reduced by 10 feet, but you count as one size larger for carrying capacity.
- **Crushing:** Speed is halved, and you have Disadvantage on Dexterity checks, but one hour of successful training counts as two hours.
Once per Long Rest, after wearing Heavy or Crushing load for at least 1 hour, you can release all weight as a Bonus Action. For 10 minutes, your Speed increases by 15 feet and your jump distances triple.

wondrous.construction: Dragon-scale jade carved as a ferry coin
wondrous.name: River-Dragon Ferry Token
wondrous.text:
As a 10-minute ritual performed beside a body of water at least 20 feet across, summon a spectral river-dragon ferry.
The ferry can carry twenty Medium creatures and 10,000 pounds of cargo. It has a Swim Speed of 100 feet and can travel continuously for 8 hours.
It ignores ordinary currents, rapids, waves, and shallows but cannot leave the water, cross a sealed boundary, or enter a space narrower than 20 feet.
Once dismissed or after 8 hours, the ferry cannot be summoned again until dawn.

wondrous.construction: Moon jade basin lined with mirror-sea silver
wondrous.name: Moonwell Reflection Basin
wondrous.text:
Fill the basin with clean water and expose it to natural moonlight for 10 minutes.
Once per Long Rest, name a location you have personally visited on the same plane. The basin shows and transmits sound from a 20-foot-radius area centered on that location for up to 10 minutes, requiring Concentration.
A location protected by a stronger concealment effect causes the water to cloud. Creatures at the viewed location can notice the observation with a successful Wisdom (Perception) check against your item save DC, perceiving a faint moonlit reflection.

wondrous.construction: Star-silver case containing twelve returning message arrows
wondrous.name: Starfall Message Arrow Case
wondrous.text:
The case holds twelve magical arrows. Each reforms in the case at dawn if lost or destroyed.
As an Action, attach a written message or object weighing no more than 1 pound to an arrow and name a creature or fixed location you know within 100 miles on the same plane.
When fired into open air, the arrow becomes a streak of starlight and travels toward the destination at 1 mile per minute. It lands harmlessly in the nearest open space.
A sealed boundary, stronger interception effect, or an inaccurate destination can prevent delivery. An undelivered arrow returns to the case after 1 hour.

wondrous.construction: Soul jade orb containing a verdant miniature sanctuary
wondrous.name: Spirit-Companion Residence Orb
wondrous.text:
The orb contains a 100-foot-radius sanctuary suitable for up to six willing spirit companions or bonded creatures, each Huge or smaller.
A companion touching the orb enters or leaves as an Action. Occupants have breathable air, clean water, appropriate ordinary shelter, and can complete Short and Long Rests if the orb remains stationary for the full rest.
A companion completing a Long Rest inside regains additional Hit Points equal to five times your Proficiency Bonus.
If the orb is destroyed, occupants appear Prone in the nearest unoccupied spaces and take `6d6` force damage.

wondrous.construction: Living paper, jade covers, and identity seals
wondrous.name: Sect Steward's Endless Ledger
wondrous.text:
The ledger stores up to one million written records without increasing in size.
It can automatically record authorized deposits, withdrawals, assignments, dues, loans, permissions, and inventory changes occurring within a linked storehouse or treasury no larger than a 300-foot-radius area.
As an Action, state a query concerning its records. The ledger presents a complete answer organized by date, person, category, or value.
It records transactions, not truth. A concealed theft or false declaration appears only if detected or entered by an authorized witness.

wondrous.construction: Moonwood token carved as a barn
wondrous.name: Harvest-Moon Storage Barn Token
wondrous.text:
As a 10-minute ritual, expand the token into a 40-foot-by-80-foot barn with a 20-foot interior height.
The barn stores up to 100,000 pounds of grain, herbs, fruit, fodder, lumber, hides, and other harvested nonliving materials.
Contents do not rot, mold, sprout, or attract ordinary vermin. The interior remains cool and dry.
The barn can be collapsed during a 10-minute ritual only while no creature is inside. Stored goods remain within the token and can be accessed only while expanded.

wondrous.construction: Nine-chamber spirit furnace, sun copper, and temper jade
wondrous.name: Blacksmith's Nine-Heat Furnace
wondrous.text:
The furnace supports crafting and repairing treasures up to Saint grade.
When beginning a project, choose one of nine heat patterns: softening, purification, alloying, tempering, quenching, inscription bonding, spirit-stone smelting, corruption burning, or repair.
You gain a +2 bonus to Blacksmith checks appropriate to the chosen pattern.
Once per Long Rest, when such a check fails by 5 or less, you can preserve all rare materials and convert the result into a delayed project requiring 25 percent additional time instead of suffering the normal failure consequence.

wondrous.construction: Seven-layer medicine jade and phoenix-ash bronze
wondrous.name: Alchemist's Seven-Petal Cauldron
wondrous.text:
The cauldron supports alchemical products up to Saint grade and can maintain seven separately sealed ingredient chambers.
You gain a +2 bonus to Alchemy checks made with it.
At the start of a project, choose one petal principle: purification, concentration, preservation, poison separation, temperature balance, qi circulation, or pill shaping. The project gains Advantage on one check directly governed by that principle.
Once per Long Rest, a failed project can produce one-half of its intended yield as Broken or weakened products instead of losing the entire batch.

wondrous.construction: Enlightenment wood, living inkstone hair, and moon-silver ferrule
wondrous.name: Calligrapher's Living-Ink Brush
wondrous.text:
The brush creates ordinary black, red, gold, or silver ink without consuming supplies.
As an Action, it can copy one visible page of nonmagical writing onto a blank page. It preserves layout and handwriting but not supernatural properties.
You gain a +2 bonus to checks made to create or repair written talismans, seals, manuals, contracts, or formation diagrams up to Saint grade.
Once per Long Rest, when such a check fails by 5 or less, the brush prevents activation and preserves all rare ink and paper for another attempt.

wondrous.construction: Rotating jade discs, star-silver pins, and source-stone channels
wondrous.name: Formation Master's Rotating Array Board
wondrous.text:
The board stores up to twelve formation layouts.
During a Short Rest, you can construct a moving three-dimensional simulation of one stored or observed Formation. You gain a +2 bonus to checks made to analyze, teach, modify, or repair that layout.
Once per Long Rest, the board can project a harmless 30-foot-radius training simulation for 10 minutes. The simulation displays lines, zones, trigger order, and predicted movement but deals no damage and creates no real conditions.

wondrous.construction: Earthwood drum, source-jade frame, and dragon-hide head
wondrous.name: Source-Reader's Earth Pulse Drum
wondrous.text:
Install the drum on natural ground and perform a 1-hour rhythm.
You learn the direction and broad distance of major mineral deposits, spirit-stone veins, underground rivers, caverns, artificial tunnels, and geomantic disruptions within 10 miles.
The drum classifies each reading as trace, minor, substantial, great, or sealed.
It does not identify specific treasure contents, creatures, traps, or a Sovereign-grade concealment. The drum can perform one regional survey per dawn.

wondrous.construction: Medicine wood, folded-space drawers, and cleansing copper
wondrous.name: Wandering Healer's Hundred-Medicine Cabinet
wondrous.text:
The cabinet weighs 20 pounds and holds up to one hundred medicine doses, healer's-kit uses, pills, tools, or biological samples without spoilage.
It has 10 Medicine charges and regains `1d6 + 4` expended charges when restocked during a Long Rest with supplies worth 1 Mid-Grade Spirit Stone.
As an Action, expend:
- **1 charge:** restore `2d8 + your Proficiency Bonus` Hit Points to a touched creature;
- **2 charges:** end one nonmagical poison or disease;
- **3 charges:** allow a touched creature to repeat one saving throw against a Saint-grade or lower poison, disease, or curse that permits repeated saves.
The cabinet cannot restore a dead creature to life.

wondrous.construction: Ancestor jade, spirit bronze, and a true-name inscription
wondrous.name: Guardian Ancestor Statue
wondrous.text:
While the statue is on your person, you cannot be surprised while conscious.
The statue has 5 charges and regains `1d4 + 1` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
**Ancestral Intercession.** When you or an ally within 30 feet takes damage, use your Reaction and expend 1 charge to reduce that damage by `3d8 + your Proficiency Bonus`.
**Guardian Manifestation.** As an Action, expend 3 charges to manifest a Large spectral guardian in an unoccupied space within 30 feet for 1 minute, requiring Concentration. Allies within 10 feet of it have Half Cover. The guardian cannot move or attack.

wondrous.construction: Dragon-patterned abyssal gold, mountain jade, and nine seal faces
wondrous.name: Nine-Dragon Binding Seal
wondrous.text:
The seal has 7 charges and regains `1d6 + 1` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
As an Action, expend 2 charges and choose one Gargantuan or smaller creature within 120 feet. It makes a Strength saving throw against your item save DC.
On a failed save, nine spectral dragons bind it for up to 1 minute, requiring Concentration. While bound, it is Restrained, cannot teleport or travel between planes, and cannot willingly move from its space.
At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on a success. On the initial successful save, its Speed is halved until the end of its next turn.
A creature that escapes is immune to the seal until the start of your next turn.

wondrous.construction: Sovereign source jade, star iron, and a floating heaven needle
wondrous.name: Source-Heaven Grand Compass

wondrous.construction: Li-fire crystal, phoenix-blood metal, and restoration inscriptions
wondrous.name: Li-Fire Restoring Furnace
wondrous.text:
The furnace repairs and purifies treasures up to Sovereign grade.
**Major Repair.** A 24-hour ritual consuming materials worth 10 High-Grade Spirit Stones restores a broken but substantially complete Sovereign-grade or lower treasure to full function.
**Reforge Fragment.** A 7-day ritual can reconstruct a destroyed treasure when at least half of its original Primary Material and its defining core, spirit, or inscription survives. The ritual consumes materials worth half the treasure's normal crafting cost.
**Burn Corruption.** A 1-hour ritual allows an ability check using appropriate crafting tools against the corruption's save DC. On a success, one curse, hostile possession, or foreign refinement is suppressed for 30 days.
The furnace cannot restore an expended consumable, recreate an absent item spirit, or repair an Immortal Artifact.

wondrous.construction: Star silver, cloud-void crystal, and celestial beastwood
wondrous.name: Star-Road Crossing Chariot
wondrous.text:
The chariot can carry twelve Medium creatures and 5,000 pounds of cargo. It has AC 20, 250 Hit Points, a ground Speed of 80 feet, and a Fly Speed of 150 feet.
While under open sky, it can enter **Star-Road Travel** after 10 minutes of uninterrupted movement. During Star-Road Travel, it covers up to 500 miles per hour and appears as a streak of light. It cannot attack, enter enclosed structures, or cross a planar boundary in this state.
Star-Road Travel can be maintained for 8 hours between Long Rests. If forced to end over unsafe terrain, the chariot descends to the nearest unoccupied ground space.

wondrous.construction: Cloud palace seed, sovereign sky jade, and formation pillars
wondrous.name: Thousand-Mile Cloud Palace
wondrous.text:
As a 1-hour ritual beneath open sky, the treasure expands into a flying palace occupying a 200-foot-square area.
The palace contains private rooms for fifty creatures, kitchens, meeting halls, training courts, protected storage for 100,000 pounds, and a central Formation chamber.
It has AC 20, 1,000 Hit Points, a Fly Speed of 100 feet, and can travel up to 1,000 miles per day. It cannot Dash, enter a space narrower than 250 feet, or travel between planes.
While stationary, the palace can hover. If reduced to 0 Hit Points, it descends safely for 1 minute before collapsing into dormant seed form. It reforms after 30 days and repairs worth 10 Perfect Spirit Stones.

wondrous.construction: Reincarnation bronze, soul jade, and karma-red flame
wondrous.name: Soul-Reincarnation Waiting Lamp

wondrous.construction: Dream crystal seed, mirror-sea silver, and moonwood
wondrous.name: Dream-Mirror Hall Seed
wondrous.text:
As a 1-hour ritual, expand the seed into a 100-foot-square hall containing sleeping chambers for twenty creatures and a central dream mirror.
Creatures completing a Long Rest inside have Advantage on saving throws against dream intrusion and magical sleep.
Once per Long Rest, up to twenty willing sleeping creatures can enter a shared dream hall for up to 8 subjective hours while only 1 real hour passes. They can converse, rehearse known techniques, review memories they voluntarily present, and create harmless symbolic environments.
The dream hall cannot grant training time, new knowledge, healing, AP, Sphere ownership, or physical items.

wondrous.construction: Five-phase alloy, sovereign furnace jade, and rotating elemental chambers
wondrous.name: Five-Phase Refinement Cauldron

wondrous.construction: Living landscape silk, mountain-root jade, and river-dragon ink
wondrous.name: Mountain-and-River Suppression Map
wondrous.text:
The map has 7 charges and regains `1d6 + 1` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
As an Action, expend 3 charges to unfold the map and create a 300-foot-radius suppression domain centered on a point you can see within 300 feet for up to 10 minutes, requiring Concentration.
Choose Mountain or River:
- **Mountain:** Hostile creatures treat the area as Difficult Terrain, cannot fly higher than 20 feet above the ground, and must succeed on a Strength saving throw when entering or starting their turn there or have Speed 0 until the start of their next turn.
- **River:** Hostile creatures are moved 20 feet in a direction you choose when they enter or start their turn there unless they succeed on a Strength saving throw. Allies can move across liquids and vertical surfaces in the area without falling during their turn.
The domain does not permanently alter terrain.

wondrous.construction: Star silver, heaven crystal, and nine rotating sky rings
wondrous.name: Sky-Watching Imperial Astrolabe
wondrous.text:
The astrolabe precisely tracks celestial bodies, planar alignment, natural weather, eclipses, meteor activity, and large atmospheric disturbances.
Once per Long Rest, perform a 1-hour observation and choose one region within 1,000 miles that you can identify.
You learn the natural weather, major celestial events, and probable supernatural atmospheric disturbances expected there during the next 7 days.
You also receive one **Favorable Alignment die**, a `d12`, lasting until your next Long Rest. After you or an ally within 30 feet makes an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, you can use your Reaction to add the die to the roll.
The astrolabe reports probability and signs, not guaranteed prophecy.

wondrous.construction: Dragon bronze, beast-sovereign bone, and command inscriptions
wondrous.name: Ten-Thousand Beast Command Bell
wondrous.text:
The bell has 7 charges and regains `1d6 + 1` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
**Command the Host.** As an Action, expend 2 charges. Beasts and Monstrosities with Intelligence 7 or lower of your choice within 120 feet that can hear the bell make a Wisdom saving throw against your item save DC.
On a failed save, a hostile creature is Charmed by you for 1 minute, requiring Concentration. While Charmed, it will not harm you or your allies and obeys simple non-suicidal commands. It repeats the save whenever it takes damage.
Willing allied beasts within range instead gain Temporary Hit Points equal to four times your Proficiency Bonus and Advantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.
A creature that succeeds is immune until your next Long Rest.

wondrous.construction: Ancestral jade, court wood, and nine true-name recesses
wondrous.name: Ancestor Court Tablet

wondrous.construction: Living red paper, black-gold script, and a blood-jade clasp
wondrous.name: Karma-Reversal Red Ledger
wondrous.text:
The ledger has 5 Karma charges and regains `1d4 + 1` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
During a Long Rest, record the true names of up to six willing creatures.
When a recorded creature within 120 feet fails an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, you can use your Reaction and expend 1 charge to let it reroll the d20 and use either result.
If the reroll changes failure to success, the ledger records a karmic debt. Before that creature completes its next Long Rest, the first time it succeeds on another d20 Test, it must roll a `d6` and subtract the result.
A creature can hold only one karmic debt at a time.

wondrous.construction: Voidglass pagoda, origin-copper nails, and boundary jade
wondrous.name: Void-Nail Boundary Pagoda

wondrous.construction: Heaven bronze, storm jade, and a suspended cloudwood beam
wondrous.name: Heaven-Sound Warning Bell

wondrous.construction: Abyssal pearl, deepsea cold iron, and ocean-dragon jade
wondrous.name: Ocean-Stilling Pearl

wondrous.construction: Tribulation silk, storm iron, and cloud-jade streamers
wondrous.name: Storm-Gathering Banner
wondrous.text:
The banner requires 10 minutes to plant and has 7 charges, regaining `1d6 + 1` after a Long Rest.
**Gather Storm.** Expend 3 charges to create a storm in a 1-mile-radius area centered on the banner for up to 1 hour. Choose rain, snow, wind, or thunderstorm when activated.
The chosen weather is severe but natural in behavior. During a thunderstorm, once on each of your turns you can use a Bonus Action to expend 1 additional charge and call lightning at a point you can see within 300 feet. Creatures in a 10-foot-radius sphere make a Dexterity saving throw against your item save DC, taking `8d8` lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
Moving or destroying the banner ends the storm. It cannot create weather impossible for the plane.

wondrous.construction: Cloud-void crystal, mirror-sea silver, and formation jade
wondrous.name: City-Veil Formation Core
wondrous.text:
The core requires 7 days to install in a settlement no larger than 1 mile across.
While active, creatures outside the boundary cannot perceive the settlement from more than 300 feet away unless they know its location or succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check. Roads appear to continue around it, distant lights vanish, and ordinary maps fail to update automatically.
The veil does not make creatures inside Invisible, prevent physical entry, or conceal activity occurring outside the boundary.
Authorized tokens permit normal perception. A Sovereign or stronger divination effect can contest the veil using its normal check against DC 17. The core consumes 1 High-Grade Spirit Stone each month.

wondrous.construction: Mountain-root jade, sovereign stone, and soul-silver eyes
wondrous.name: Sect-Guardian Stone Lion Pair
wondrous.text:
The matched lions require 8 hours to install within 60 feet of one another.
While dormant, each statue has AC 20, 250 Hit Points, and Immunity to poison and psychic damage. When an unauthorized hostile creature enters the protected 300-foot-radius area, both awaken for up to 10 minutes.
Each lion is a Huge Construct with Speed 50 feet. On the installation's initiative count, each can move and make one melee item attack using `+11` to hit, Reach 10 feet, dealing `4d10 + 6` bludgeoning damage.
A creature hit must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked Prone.
The lions cannot leave the protected area. If destroyed, a lion requires materials worth 5 High-Grade Spirit Stones and 7 days to rebuild.

wondrous.construction: Ten thousand linked jade slips and a sovereign memory core
wondrous.name: Thousand-Script Jade Library
wondrous.text:
The library stores up to ten thousand books, manuals, maps, recordings, memories, or inscription patterns without changing size.
As an Action, state a query. The library presents every stored passage relevant to that query and identifies contradictions among stored sources without deciding which is correct.
A creature studying within 30 feet for at least 1 hour gains Advantage on one Intelligence check made before its next Long Rest concerning a subject represented in the archive.
Once per Long Rest, the attuned bearer can create a perfect nonmagical copy of one stored text of up to 1,000 pages.
The library does not grant a Sphere, Talent, Recorded Art, language, or prerequisite. Learning still uses the normal training rules.

wondrous.construction: Dragon-pulse iron, source jade, and world-root wood
wondrous.name: Spirit-Vein Relocation Spade

wondrous.construction: World-tree rootwood, living jade, and sovereign spirit soil
wondrous.name: World-Tree Sapling Urn

wondrous.construction: Phoenix-blood metal, rebirth ash, and sun-gold inscriptions
wondrous.name: Phoenix-Nest Rebirth Brazier
wondrous.text:
The brazier must remain lit with incense and fuel worth 1 High-Grade Spirit Stone per week.
When a willing creature registered to the brazier dies within 1 mile, its body and carried non-artifact equipment are transported into the brazier's chamber if dimensional travel is not blocked.
For the next 24 hours, the creature can be restored to life by an 8-hour ritual consuming materials worth 10 High-Grade Spirit Stones. The creature returns with 1 Hit Point and 3 levels of Exhaustion.
The brazier can register up to twelve creatures and restore one creature per month. It cannot restore a soul that is unwilling, destroyed, imprisoned elsewhere, or already reincarnated.

wondrous.construction: Blood jade, mirror-sea silver, and ancestral gate inscriptions
wondrous.name: Bloodline-Ancestral Gate Mirror
wondrous.text:
The mirror can store the verified blood signatures of up to one hundred willing creatures.
During a 1-hour ritual, link it to one fixed mirror or ancestral gate on the same plane within 1,000 miles. A registered creature can use an Action to pass through and emerge from the linked gate.
The gate transports up to twenty creatures or 5,000 pounds of unattended cargo between Long Rests.
An unregistered creature can pass only while holding the hand of a registered creature that willingly escorts it. A sealed boundary or stronger Space effect can block transit.
The mirror verifies blood relationship but does not determine legitimacy, inheritance rights, or moral worth.

wondrous.construction: Tribulation steel, nine-layer formation jade, and stormglass
wondrous.name: Ninefold Tribulation Shelter
wondrous.text:
As a 1-hour ritual, expand the shelter into a 60-foot-radius domed pavilion lasting up to 24 hours.
The shelter has AC 21, 500 Hit Points, and Resistance to all damage. Creatures and objects inside have Total Cover from effects originating outside.
Whenever the shelter takes acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, radiant, necrotic, or thunder damage, it adapts. After taking a damage type, it gains Immunity to that type until the end of the next round.
The shelter can withstand one breakthrough or natural tribulation at a time. It does not weaken the tribulation's requirements, grant success, or protect a creature that leaves the dome.
Once collapsed or destroyed, it cannot be used again for 30 days.

wondrous.construction: Star iron, sovereign furnace jade, and gravity inscriptions
wondrous.name: Starfall Ore Refinement Crucible

wondrous.construction: Ghost-court jade, black-gold law script, and funeral bronze
wondrous.name: Ghost-Court Judgment Seal
wondrous.text:
The seal has 7 charges and regains `1d6 + 1` after a Long Rest.
As an Action, expend 2 charges and choose one visible Undead, spirit, possessing entity, or soul-bound creature within 60 feet. It makes a Charisma saving throw against your item save DC.
On a failed save, spectral court chains bind it for 1 minute, requiring Concentration. While bound, it cannot become Invisible, possess a creature, travel between planes, or knowingly speak a lie.
At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save.
During the binding, you can ask up to three questions. The seal compels audible answers but does not compel completeness or knowledge the creature lacks.
A creature that succeeds on the initial save is immune until your next Long Rest.

wondrous.construction: Blood jade, star silver, and a void-pointing needle
wondrous.name: Thousand-Li Pursuit Compass
wondrous.text:
During a 10-minute ritual, place a physical trace from a creature on the compass. The trace must be no more than 30 days old.
For 7 days, while the creature remains on the same plane and within 1,000 miles, the compass displays its direction, straight-line distance, and whether it is moving.
A willing creature can instead register itself by touching the compass, requiring no physical trace.
A Sovereign or stronger concealment effect can block the reading. The compass cannot cross planar boundaries, identify disguises, or track a creature whose body and soul have both been fundamentally transformed.
The compass can track one creature at a time.

wondrous.construction: Ancient ash, memory jade, and sealed bronze
wondrous.name: Forgotten-Age Ash Urn
wondrous.text:
The urn contains ash that records traces left by destruction.
Once per Long Rest, scatter a pinch over a ruined object, burned structure, battlefield, grave, or destroyed Formation Anchor and spend 10 minutes observing.
You witness a silent, translucent reconstruction of one significant event that occurred at that location within the previous 1,000 years, lasting no more than 10 minutes.
The urn selects the event most strongly associated with destruction, death, betrayal, or final use. The vision is a residual impression, not time travel, and can omit concealed details or subjective information.
An Imperial concealment or deliberate historical erasure can block the vision.

wondrous.construction: Heaven silk, karma-red thread, and starwood frame
wondrous.name: Heaven-Thread Fate Loom
wondrous.text:
During a Long Rest, up to six willing creatures can each contribute one personal thread, hair, signature, or drop of blood.
The loom creates three **Fate Threads**, each represented by a `d12`. The threads last until the next Long Rest.
When a contributing creature within 120 feet makes an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, the attuned bearer can use a Reaction and expend one Fate Thread to add its die after the roll but before the outcome is declared.
Alternatively, when such a creature is hit, expend one Fate Thread to subtract its die from the attack roll.
Unused Fate Threads vanish. The loom cannot guarantee prophecy, restore a spent thread, or affect an Immortal decree.

wondrous.construction: Voidfold wood, merchant jade, and city-silk awnings
wondrous.name: Voidfold Merchant Pavilion
wondrous.text:
As a 1-hour ritual, expand the token into a 100-foot-square market pavilion.
It contains twenty secure stalls, six private negotiation rooms, storage for 100,000 pounds of goods, and a central ledger chamber.
Goods stored in a locked stall cannot be removed without its assigned token unless a creature succeeds on a DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check during a 10-minute procedure.
The pavilion records every declared sale, deposit, withdrawal, and transfer but cannot detect unreported deception.
It can remain expanded indefinitely while supplied with 1 High-Grade Spirit Stone per month. It collapses only while empty of creatures, retaining stored goods in extradimensional storage.

wondrous.construction: Sun gold, moon silver, and a sovereign star crystal
wondrous.name: Sun-and-Moon Timekeeping Wheel
wondrous.text:
The wheel displays exact local time, date, season, lunar phase, solar position, and the rate at which time is passing relative to the plane where it was created.
Within 300 feet, it prevents ordinary clocks, calendars, and natural cycles from being falsified by a Sovereign-grade or weaker illusion.
Once per Long Rest, perform a 10-minute reading to learn whether a creature, object, or location within 30 feet is currently affected by accelerated, slowed, suspended, repeated, or displaced time.
The wheel does not alter time, reveal the future, or measure an Immortal time effect precisely.

wondrous.construction: Dragon-pattern stone, source jade, and sovereign bronze
wondrous.name: Dragon-Pulse Surveying Pillar
wondrous.text:
The pillar requires 24 hours to install and surveys a 100-mile-radius region.
It continuously maps major spirit veins, dragon pulses, groundwater, mineral concentrations, seismic stress, corrupted zones, Formation Anchors, and artificial diversions.
Authorized creatures can study the map for 10 minutes to gain Advantage on one check made within 24 hours to navigate, build, cultivate, place a Formation, locate a vein, or predict a natural disaster in the surveyed region.
The pillar cannot reveal a deliberately concealed Imperial site, living creature, exact treasure, or safe path through a ward.

wondrous.construction: Soul jade, deepsea cold iron, and nine preservation seals
wondrous.name: Nascent Soul Preservation Casket

wondrous.construction: Imperial-style jade, sovereign gold, and voice-memory crystal
wondrous.name: Emperor's Mandate Relay Seal
wondrous.text:
During an 8-hour rite, one recognized ruler, sect master, or authorized office records a mandate of no more than 1,000 words and names up to one hundred relay seals.
A bearer can use an Action to transmit the mandate to every linked seal on the same plane within 10,000 miles. Each seal reproduces the issuer's image, voice, date, and authentication mark for up to 10 minutes.
A linked seal can return one response of no more than 250 words within 1 hour.
The seal verifies that the message came from the recorded office. It does not compel obedience, prove the mandate is lawful, or grant authority to an unauthorized bearer.

wondrous.construction: Dragon-patterned abyssal gold, mother-weight essence, and furnace jade
wondrous.name: Cauldron of Ten Thousand Burdens
wondrous.text:
The cauldron can refine up to 100,000 pounds of material during a 7-day process.
Within its chamber, effective weight can be set from one-hundredth to one hundred times normal. This permits pressure forging, density separation, compression, stabilization, and controlled burden training.
You gain a +4 bonus to Alchemy, Blacksmith, and material-refinement checks made with the cauldron.
Once per month, it can condense compatible Sovereign-grade materials worth 10 Perfect Spirit Stones into one Imperial-grade component of equal value, provided the correct Imperial catalyst and formula are supplied.
The cauldron cannot create Immortal matter, grant a cultivation Realm, or safely refine a living creature without a specific procedure.

wondrous.construction: Cloud-void silk, heaven-mark violet gold, and mirror mist
wondrous.name: Heaven-Veil Imperial Mantle
wondrous.text:
While wearing the mantle, you have Resistance to force and psychic damage.
You can become Invisible as a Bonus Action. The invisibility lasts until you dismiss it, attack, deal damage, force a saving throw, or spend CP. You can use this property repeatedly.
The mantle has 5 Veil charges and regains `1d4 + 1` after a Long Rest.
When you are targeted by an attack or hostile effect, use your Reaction and expend 1 charge to teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. If the new position is no longer a legal target, the triggering effect fails against you.
An Imperial or Immortal effect that seals space can prevent the teleportation.

wondrous.construction: Heaven bronze, Imperial storm jade, and a spirit-vein clapper
wondrous.name: Sect-Guardian Heaven Bell

wondrous.construction: Nine star-stone rings, Imperial silver, and celestial coordinates
wondrous.name: Nine-Heavens Star-Road Altar
wondrous.text:
The altar requires 30 days to install and can link to up to eight other attuned Star-Road Altars on the same plane.
Once per day, after a 10-minute activation, it opens a stable gate between two linked altars for 1 hour.
The gate can transport creatures, vehicles, and cargo through an opening 30 feet wide and 30 feet high. Up to 10,000 creatures or 1,000,000 pounds of cargo can pass during one activation.
The gate cannot cross planes, open into a moving altar, or function while either destination is under an Imperial spatial seal.
Activating the altar consumes 1 Perfect Spirit Stone.

wondrous.construction: Five Imperial divine metals and a world-furnace core
wondrous.name: Five-Emperors World-Refining Furnace

wondrous.construction: Dragon-vein jade, Imperial mountain stone, and gate gold
wondrous.name: Dragon-Vein Mountain Gate Seal

wondrous.construction: Phoenix-blood scarlet gold, palace seedwood, and rebirth flame
wondrous.name: Phoenix Rebirth Palace Seed
wondrous.text:
As a 24-hour ritual, expand the seed into a 500-foot-square palace containing recovery chambers for one hundred creatures.
A creature completing a Long Rest inside removes two additional levels of Exhaustion and can repeat one saving throw against every poison, disease, curse, or spiritual injury that permits repeated saves.
Once per month, the palace can restore one willing creature that died within the previous 30 days. The rite requires its body or at least half its remains, its willing soul, 24 hours, and materials worth 10 Perfect Spirit Stones.
The creature returns with full Hit Points, 4 levels of Exhaustion, and no expended Path resources.
The palace cannot restore a destroyed soul, an Immortal being, or a creature whose death is enforced by a stronger mandate.

wondrous.construction: Sea-sovereign pearl, abyssal gold, and dragon-pressure crystal
wondrous.name: Ocean-Subduing Sovereign Pearl
wondrous.text:
While carrying the pearl, you can breathe water, gain a Swim Speed of 120 feet, and are immune to ordinary water pressure and forced movement caused by water.
The pearl has 9 charges and regains `1d8 + 1` after a Long Rest.
**Subdue the Ocean.** As an Action, expend 5 charges to control water in a 10-mile-radius area for up to 1 hour, requiring Concentration. You can calm or raise waves, redirect currents, open a dry passage up to 300 feet wide, lower or raise local water level by up to 100 feet, or restrain one water-based Imperial effect using an opposed ability check.
The effect cannot drain an ocean, flood an entire continent, or override an Immortal water law.

wondrous.construction: World-beast jade, pavilion seedwood, and soul-safe enclosures
wondrous.name: Ten-Thousand Spirit Bestiary Pavilion

wondrous.construction: Imperial ancestor jade, court gold, and a hundred true-name tablets
wondrous.name: Imperial Ancestor Court

wondrous.construction: Imperial mirror glass, heaven crystal, and a 300-foot tower
wondrous.name: Heaven-Observing Mirror Tower

wondrous.construction: Karma gold, black-white jade, and judgment inscriptions
wondrous.name: Karma-Judgment Golden Scale

wondrous.construction: World-root wood, Imperial earth gold, and living source jade
wondrous.name: World-Root Transplantation Spade

wondrous.construction: Origin-void copper, Imperial jade, and a world-sail
wondrous.name: Void-Crossing Jade Ark
wondrous.text:
The ark can carry 1,000 Medium creatures and 1,000,000 pounds of cargo. It has AC 23, 2,000 Hit Points, a Fly Speed of 200 feet, and environmental protection for all occupants.
After a 1-hour navigation ritual, it can cross to another known plane or demiplane. The crossing takes 1d6 hours and consumes 1 Perfect Spirit Stone.
During transit, the ark exists in a protected void corridor. Occupants cannot leave, attack outside, or complete a Long Rest unless the journey lasts at least 8 hours.
A sealed plane, inaccurate destination, or Immortal boundary can prevent arrival. On failure, the ark returns to its point of departure without consuming the stone.
If destroyed in transit, it automatically attempts an emergency return before breaking apart.

wondrous.construction: Imperial dream crystal, moon gold, and a palace flame
wondrous.name: Thousand-Dream Palace Lantern
wondrous.text:
The lantern can create a shared dream palace for up to one thousand willing sleeping creatures within 10 miles.
One real hour equals up to eight subjective hours in the palace. Participants can converse, exchange voluntarily presented memories, rehearse known techniques, conduct councils, and create harmless symbolic environments.
Participants cannot gain training days, AP, permanent abilities, physical items, Hit Points, or Path resources from subjective time.
The bearer can exclude or awaken any participant as an Action.
Once per Long Rest, the palace can trap one hostile dream intruder that fails a Charisma saving throw against your item save DC. The intruder is expelled and cannot enter the dreams of registered participants for 30 days.

wondrous.construction: Heaven-mark violet gold, star jade, and ten thousand command pins
wondrous.name: Celestial Formation Command Board

wondrous.construction: Nine sun-gold layers, calamity crystal, and phoenix-blood metal
wondrous.name: Nine-Sun Calamity Shelter
wondrous.text:
As a 1-hour ritual, expand the shelter into a 300-foot-radius dome lasting 24 hours.
The dome has AC 23, 2,000 Hit Points, Resistance to all damage, and nine Sun Layers. When the dome would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, one Sun Layer is destroyed and the dome returns to 500 Hit Points.
Creatures inside have Total Cover from outside effects and Resistance to all damage caused by a breakthrough, tribulation, natural disaster, or siege effect.
Each destroyed Sun Layer reforms after 30 days and materials worth 1 Perfect Spirit Stone.
The shelter does not reduce a breakthrough's difficulty, grant success, or protect creatures outside the dome.

wondrous.construction: Moon-palace jade, Imperial cold silver, and soul-preservation crystal
wondrous.name: Moon-Palace Preservation Coffin

wondrous.construction: Immortal-tear verdant gold, medicine king wood, and one thousand jade drawers
wondrous.name: Imperial Medicine King's Cabinet

wondrous.construction: Heaven-mark gold, mandate jade, and world-spanning voice crystal
wondrous.name: Heaven-Mandate Transmission Seal
wondrous.text:
The seal can link to up to ten thousand authorized relay seals on the same plane.
As an Action, transmit a message of up to 10,000 words, a visible image, a map, an authenticated order, or a 10-minute speech to every linked seal. Delivery is immediate anywhere on the plane unless blocked by an Immortal boundary.
The seal verifies the sender's identity, office, date, and unaltered content.
Once per Long Rest, the bearer can open a 1-hour council link among up to one hundred linked seals, allowing simultaneous sight and sound.
The seal does not compel obedience, create legitimate authority, alter law, or authenticate a bearer not recognized by the network's installation rite.
